professions.name: Electrician
duties: Install, terminate, and test electrical wiring, conduits, and cable trays according to DEWA and approved drawings.
Assemble, dress, and commission main distribution boards (MDBs), sub-DBs, and breaker panels.
Diagnose and repair electrical faults, short circuits, voltage drops, and tripping breakers.
Replace faulty switches, isolators, light fixtures, sockets, and motor starters.
Carry out scheduled preventative maintenance on electrical distribution networks and transformers.
Check insulation resistance and earth loop impedance using megohmmeters and multimeters.
Comply strictly with safety protocols including Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) and PPE usage.
Pull low-voltage and control cables through conduits and underfloor trunking systems.
Coordinate with site supervisors and MEP engineers during layout inspections.
Maintain accurate daily logs of completed repairs, load tests, and consumed materials.
professions.summary: Certified and detail-oriented Electrician with comprehensive expertise in commercial, residential, and industrial low-voltage electrical systems. Skilled in interpreting technical schematics, installing conduits, assembling distribution boards, and executing complex circuit troubleshooting. Dedicated to adhering to strict safety protocols, including LOTO procedures and local DEWA electrical compliance regulations. Proven ability to deliver preventative maintenance, load balancing, and rapid fault resolution to maintain uninterrupted power reliability.

professions.name: Plumber
duties: Lay out, assemble, and install water supply networks using PPR, PEX, copper, and PVC piping.
Rough-in soil, waste, and vent lines strictly following local building and municipal codes.
Mount and connect sanitary ware, including water closets, wash basins, bathtubs, and concealed cisterns.
Conduct hydrostatic pressure testing on water pipelines to identify leaks before wall closure.
Inspect, clear, and clean clogged drains, sewer pipes, grease traps, and manholes.
Install and troubleshoot booster pumps, submersible drainage pumps, and float switches.
Service and replace water heaters, PRVs (pressure reducing valves), and gate valves.
Cut, thread, and braze metal pipes using manual and powered pipe-threading machines.
Monitor water storage tanks, check float valves, and coordinate tank cleaning schedules.
Document material requisitions and report major pipe corrosion or network failures.
professions.summary: Results-driven Plumber experienced in assembling, repairing, and maintaining commercial and residential water supply and drainage networks. Proficient in PPR heat fusion welding, pressure testing, hydrostatic leak detection, and sanitary ware fixture installation. Committed to executing installations strictly according to approved blueprints and municipal building codes. Adept at troubleshooting booster pumps, clearing blocked lines, and servicing valves to prevent operational disruptions.

professions.name: CCTV Technician
duties: Run, bundle, and terminate Cat6 network cables and coaxial wires through conduits and risers.
Mount analog and IP cameras (dome, bullet, PTZ) on ceilings, walls, and external poles.
Configure NVRs, DVRs, storage arrays, and network switches with assigned IP schemes.
Aim, focus, and calibrate camera lenses to ensure optimal field of view and coverage.
Ensure installation layouts strictly adhere to Dubai SIRA / local police security regulations.
Troubleshoot signal loss, IP conflicts, blurry feeds, and faulty power-over-Ethernet (PoE) ports.
Configure motion detection zones, recording schedules, frame rates, and video retention settings.
Set up remote viewing clients, control room monitors, and video management software (VMS).
Perform routine cleaning of camera lenses, weatherproof housings, and cooling fans.
Assist SIRA inspection engineers during annual audits and obtain handover approvals.
professions.summary: Skilled Security Systems and CCTV Technician proficient in end-to-end installation, termination, and calibration of surveillance networks. Expert in deploying IP, analog, and PTZ cameras, configuring NVR/DVR storage arrays, and running structured Cat6 cabling. Thorough understanding of SIRA technical standards, regulatory compliance, and remote monitoring integration. Recognized for systematic diagnostic ability in resolving signal losses, network IP conflicts, and power delivery issues.

professions.name: Security Guard
duties: Control entry and exit points by checking passes, tenant IDs, and logging visitor details.
Conduct regular foot patrols across designated perimeters, stairwells, and parking zones.
Monitor live CCTV screens in security rooms and respond immediately to suspicious activities.
Screen vehicles, verify delivery gate passes, and guide drivers to designated loading bays.
Defuse verbal disputes calmly and professionally without escalating into physical confrontations.
Respond to fire alarms, investigate the trigger point, and assist in building evacuations.
Inspect doors, windows, gates, and emergency exits at shift end to ensure premises are locked.
Maintain an accurate daily duty logbook detailing handovers, incidents, and lost property.
Enforce site health, safety, and security policies among visitors and contracted workers.
Coordinate with local emergency services (police, ambulance, civil defence) during crises.
professions.summary: Vigilant and SIRA-licensed Security Guard with demonstrated capability in access control, static guarding, and perimeter surveillance. Adept at screening visitors, inspecting vehicles, monitoring active CCTV screens, and de-escalating verbal conflicts calmly. Trained in emergency response procedures, building evacuations, and standard life safety protocols. Committed to maintaining detailed daily incident logs and projecting a professional, authoritative presence on site.

professions.name: Nurse
duties: Measure and record patients' vital signs including blood pressure, pulse, temperature, and SpO2.
Administer prescribed medications, injections, and intravenous fluids following the 5 Rights.
Perform clinical triage, record medical histories, and report changes in patient conditions to doctors.
Clean, dress, and manage surgical wounds, incisions, and pressure ulcers under sterile technique.
Insert and maintain peripheral IV lines, urinary catheters, and nasogastric tubes.
Maintain electronic medical records (EMR) accurately in compliance with DHA/MOH/DOH standards.
Prepare patients and assist physicians during minor procedures, physical exams, and lab draws.
Ensure strict adherence to hospital infection control, hygiene, and biomedical waste disposal.
Educate patients and families regarding medication schedules, home care, and post-discharge recovery.
Manage emergency resuscitations and initiate basic life support (BLS) protocols when required.
professions.summary: Compassionate and licensed Registered Nurse equipped with extensive clinical expertise across inpatient care and outpatient triage settings. Proficient in administering medications, performing IV cannulations, managing complex surgical wounds, and monitoring patient vitals. Dedicated to upholding strict infection control measures, patient confidentiality, and hospital healthcare regulations. Skilled communicator who collaborates effectively with multidisciplinary medical teams to achieve optimal patient outcomes.

professions.name: Helper
duties: Load, unload, and carry building materials, equipment, and consumables around the worksite.
Clean work areas, sweep debris, remove scrap, and dispose of waste into designated skips.
Fetch tools, equipment, cables, and materials for senior technicians and tradesmen.
Hold ladders, support workpieces, and assist craftsmen during heavy installations.
Mix mortar, concrete, adhesive, or paint under the guidance of skilled masons or painters.
Organize site stores, stack boxes neatly, and help with periodic physical counts.
Clean, oil, and store tools, machinery, and equipment properly at the end of each shift.
Dig small trenches, chip excess plaster, or clear pathways manually using hand tools.
Follow site safety rules, wear required PPE, and watch out for hazards around tradesmen.
Assist in loading scrap, trash, and packaging materials onto disposal trucks.
professions.summary: Hardworking and dependable General Helper with experience supporting construction, MEP, and facility maintenance operations. Skilled in safe material handling, organizing tool inventories, assisting skilled craftsmen, and maintaining tidy work zones. Committed to workplace safety, consistently wearing assigned personal protective equipment and following strict site instructions. Proactive team player capable of handling strenuous manual labor and repetitive tasks efficiently.

professions.name: Assistant Electrician
duties: Pull single-core and multi-core electrical wires through conduits, GI trunking, and trays.
Cut, thread, and fix PVC and GI conduits under the direction of the lead electrician.
Strip cable jackets, crimp terminals, and prepare conductors for switchboard terminations.
Mount back-boxes, surface boxes, light switches, and 13A socket faceplates.
Fetch required electrical components, testing meters, and hand tools from the site store.
Assist the lead electrician in holding heavy light fixtures, cable reels, and busbar sections.
Drill holes, install wall plugs, and secure conduit saddle clips neatly.
Clean and pack away electrical test kits, power tools, and drop cords after work.
Verify that work surfaces are clean and isolated before opening live panels.
Help trace simple cable runs and assist in continuity testing using multimeters.
professions.summary: Supportive and safety-conscious Assistant Electrician experienced in assisting lead electricians on commercial and residential installations. Proficient in pulling cables, cutting and threading conduits, fixing backboxes, and mounting terminal fixtures. Knowledgeable in basic circuit testing, hand and power tool operation, and cable preparation techniques. Dedicated to maintaining clean work areas, gathering required materials, and adhering strictly to electrical safety rules.

professions.name: Assistant Plumber
duties: Measure, mark, and cut PVC, PPR, and drainage pipes using hand saws and pipe cutters.
Clean, ream, and deburr pipe edges prior to solvent cementing or heat fusion.
Assist the plumber in carrying, holding, and securing sanitary fixtures and cast-iron fittings.
Dig and backfill shallow trenches for external water lines and sewer connections.
Apply Teflon tape to threaded joints and assemble basic fittings like elbows, tees, and unions.
Assist during pipeline pressure testing by monitoring test gauges and visually spotting leaks.
Carry and position pipe threading machines, drain snakes, and core drill rigs.
Clean floor traps, manhole covers, and strainers during preventative maintenance rounds.
Maintain plumbing toolkits, replace worn blades, and ensure heat welding irons are clean.
Transport spare parts, sealants, gaskets, and replacement valves from stores to site.
professions.summary: Reliable and motivated Assistant Plumber skilled in supporting piping installation, routine servicing, and site maintenance projects. Capable of cutting, measuring, deburring, and preparing PVC, PPR, and copper pipes for seamless jointing. Experienced in excavating trenches, carrying sanitary fittings, and assisting with pipeline pressure tests. Eager learner committed to job-site safety, tool maintenance, and rapid response to lead plumber directives.

professions.name: HVAC Technician
duties: Inspect, service, and maintain FCUs, AHUs, split ACs, and package units.
Measure suction and discharge pressures to detect low refrigerant or system overcharge.
Evacuate AC systems, perform nitrogen leak checks, and charge R410A/R134a/R32 refrigerants.
Clean or replace dirty air filters, wash evaporator/condenser coils, and flush condensate drain pans.
Diagnose compressor failures, worn contactors, faulty capacitors, and tripped motor overloads.
Braze copper refrigeration lines using oxy-acetylene torches and verify zero-leak joints.
Test and replace digital thermostats, actuator valves, temperature sensors, and VFDs.
Check blower belt tension, align pulleys, grease bearings, and check fan motor currents.
Balance air supply and extract volume across rooms using an anemometer or hood.
Complete maintenance service sheets and submit logs to MEP maintenance supervisors.
professions.summary: Performance-oriented HVAC Technician with deep technical knowledge in servicing, maintaining, and troubleshooting FCUs, AHUs, and DX units. Proficient in refrigerant charging, compressor diagnostics, system brazing, and psychrometric airflow balancing. Committed to optimizing cooling efficiency, reducing equipment downtime, and executing planned preventative maintenance schedules. Adept at diagnosing electrical control malfunctions, thermostats, and variable frequency drives on commercial properties.

professions.name: AC Mechanic
duties: Dismantle, overhaul, and repair reciprocating and scroll compressors on commercial units.
Remove, clean, descale, and reinstall blocked air-cooled and water-cooled condenser coils.
Replace worn blower bearings, fan shafts, drive belts, and dynamically balance impellers.
Flush contaminated refrigerant circuits using approved solvents and install liquid line filter-driers.
Align motor-compressor pulleys and shafts using dial indicators to eliminate harmful vibration.
Troubleshoot electrical control circuits, safety cut-outs, high/low pressure switches, and timers.
Safely recover and recycle used refrigerants into recovery cylinders following environmental rules.
Replace failed expansion valves (TXV/EEV), solenoid valves, and reversing valves on heat pumps.
Repair split and package AC sheet metal casings, replace worn thermal insulation, and patch leaks.
Test running amperages, winding resistances, and operating voltages against manufacturer nameplates.
professions.summary: Practical AC Mechanic experienced in mechanical repairs, overhauls, and chemical cleaning of cooling and air conditioning systems. Skilled in diagnosing compressor internal faults, replacing worn blower bearings, aligning fan belts, and patching coil leaks. Dedicated to recovering refrigerants safely, flushing contaminated pipe systems, and verifying electrical running amperages. Proven track record of restoring cooling efficiency in high-ambient temperature operational environments.

professions.name: Chiller Plant Technician
duties: Monitor and operate central water-cooled and air-cooled chiller plants, checking operating logs hourly.
Inspect and service primary and secondary chilled water pumps, including mechanical seals and bearings.
Test chiller oil levels, draw samples for acid/moisture laboratory testing, and replace oil filters.
Clean, brush, and descale shell-and-tube condenser and evaporator heat exchanger tubes.
Inspect cooling tower fan gearboxes, drive belts, spray nozzles, and clean basin drift eliminators.
Verify chilled water supply and return temperatures, flow rates, and delta-T across plant loops.
Recover, evacuate, and charge large-volume refrigerants (such as R134a and R123) safely.
Calibrate low-temperature freeze protection switches, differential pressure sensors, and flow switches.
Coordinate with water treatment contractors to maintain biocides, scale inhibitors, and pH levels.
Troubleshoot microprocessor chiller control panels, alarms, surge conditions, and starter faults.
professions.summary: Specialized Chiller Plant Technician with extensive operational background in managing water-cooled and air-cooled centrifugal and screw chillers. Expert in monitoring chiller plant performance logs, servicing primary and secondary chilled water pumps, and maintaining cooling towers. Proficient in water treatment verification, tube descaling, refrigerant management, and PLC control troubleshooting. Focused on improving plant thermodynamic efficiency, ensuring continuous facility cooling, and mitigating equipment breakdown risks.

professions.name: Duct Fabricator
duties: Read mechanical HVAC shop drawings to calculate duct cut dimensions, offsets, and transitions.
Mark and lay out sheet metal patterns manually or operate computerized CNC plasma cutting tables.
Cut galvanized iron (GI) and mild steel sheets using hand shears, throatless shears, or power nibblers.
Form longitudinal seams such as Pittsburgh locks, snap locks, and standing seams on folding machines.
Fabricate elbows, reducers, square-to-round transitions, branches, and plenum boxes.
Assemble duct sections using transverse duct flange (TDF/TDC) systems and slide-on flanges.
Apply fiberglass blanket, acoustic lining, or rockwool insulation using approved contact adhesives.
Seal longitudinal and transverse sheet metal joints with UL-listed mastic or duct sealant.
Inspect completed duct fittings against approved tolerances and duct construction standards.
Maintain bending brakes, lock formers, and roll formers, keeping work areas free of metal shavings.
professions.summary: Skilled Sheet Metal Duct Fabricator proficient in manufacturing rectangular, spiral, and specialized ventilation ducting systems. Adept at interpreting mechanical HVAC shop drawings, developing accurate metal cut sheets, and operating CNC plasma cutting tables. Experienced in forming Pittsburgh lock seams, transverse duct flanges (TDF/TDC), and applying internal acoustic insulation. Committed to delivering structurally sound duct assemblies within precise project tolerances and material specifications.

professions.name: Duct Installer
duties: Drill concrete slabs and fix drop rods, unistrut channels, and duct suspension hangers.
Lift, hoist, and align fabricated GI rectangular and spiral ductwork at designated ceiling elevations.
Bolt TDF/TDC duct flanges using gaskets, corner clamps, and cleat connectors.
Install manual volume control dampers (VCD), motorized smoke dampers, and fire dampers in risers.
Connect run-outs from rigid duct branches to plenum boxes using insulated flexible ducts and jubilee clips.
Mount supply air diffusers, linear slot diffusers, extract grilles, and external louvers.
Apply vapor barrier tapes, adhesive pins, and aluminum cladding on exposed rooftop ducts.
Conduct duct light tests and smoke tests to detect air leaks prior to final ceiling closure.
Coordinate duct routing with fire protection pipes, electrical containment, and structural beams.
Follow site working-at-height guidelines, using harness tie-offs on scaffold towers and MEWPs.
professions.summary: Quality-driven HVAC Duct Installer with practical experience in assembling and hanging complete air distribution networks on-site. Proficient in installing threaded rod suspensions, unistrut channels, fire dampers, and flexible duct branch connections. Skilled in aligning grilles, diffusers, and external weather louvers while coordinating with other ceiling-level services. Dedicated to safety protocols at elevated heights and ensuring leak-free connections verified via duct pressure testing.

professions.name: Pipe Fitter
duties: Interpret piping isometric drawings, weld maps, and piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs).
Measure, mark, and cut steel, carbon, and stainless-steel pipes using pipe cutters or abrasive saws.
Bevel pipe ends to specific angles using hand grinders to prepare joints for certified welders.
Align, space, and fit pipe spools, valves, and tees using alignment clamps, squares, and levels.
Bolt up raised-face and flat-face flanges, tightening bolts in cross-pattern sequences to specified torques.
Cut, thread, and ream black iron and galvanized steel pipes using rigid threading machines.
Fabricate and mount heavy-duty pipe supports, roller guides, anchors, and spring hangers.
Install inline equipment such as strainers, non-return valves, butterfly valves, and expansion joints.
Blind off piping sections and install test manifolds to prepare networks for hydrostatic testing.
Remove blanks, temporary spool pieces, and test strainers after flushing and hydrostatic approval.
professions.summary: Precision-focused Pipe Fitter with substantial background in industrial piping, chilled water networks, and high-pressure fluid systems. Highly proficient in reading isometric drawings, marking cut lines, beveling edges, and aligning flanges for certified welders. Skilled in cutting, threading, and grooving carbon steel and GI piping, as well as fabricating heavy pipe supports. Thorough understanding of hydrostatic pressure testing, pipeline flushing, and mechanical assembly procedures.

professions.name: Elevator Technician
duties: Inspect, service, and maintain passenger lifts, service elevators, escalators, and moving walks.
Test elevator safety circuits, emergency stop buttons, governor switches, and door interlocks.
Adjust, lubricate, and clean car door operators, door rollers, tracks, and landing sill gates.
Inspect traction hoisting steel wire ropes for fraying, wear, tension differences, and crown breaks.
Check car and counterweight guide rails, inspect guide shoes, and top up automatic rail lubricators.
Troubleshoot VVVF drive faults, relay logic, floor selector switches, and electronic controller boards.
Conduct annual full-load safety brake drop tests and buffer impact tests as required by safety codes.
Check escalator step chains, handrail drive belts, comb plates, and missing step detection switches.
Respond to elevator breakdown calls, passenger entrapments, and perform emergency car evacuations.
Maintain detailed maintenance logbooks on site, recording rope adjustments and component replacements.
professions.summary: Certified Elevator Technician experienced in preventative maintenance, fault diagnosis, and modernization of passenger lifts and escalators. Proficient in inspecting traction hoisting wire ropes, adjusting car door interlocks, and tuning VVVF drive controllers. Committed to passenger safety through regular testing of safety gear, emergency governors, and hydraulic buffers. Responsive troubleshooter capable of executing prompt, safe passenger rescue operations during sudden entrapments.

professions.name: Fire Alarm Technician
duties: Install, wire, and address intelligent analog/addressable fire alarm panels, repeaters, and field devices.
Run, terminate, and test fire-resistant cables (FP200/MICC) in loops to avoid signal drops and earth faults.
Test smoke detectors, heat detectors, beam detectors, and manual call points using test aerosols and poles.
Program cause-and-effect matrix logic into fire alarm control panels (FACP) using vendor software.
Troubleshoot loop open circuits, short circuits, device misaddresses, and communication failures.
Connect interfaces to trip HVAC units, recall elevators, close fire doors, and release access doors.
Wire and test evacuation horn strobes, sounder bases, voice evacuation speakers, and flashers.
Conduct periodic battery load tests on panel standby batteries to confirm autonomy runtimes.
Coordinate with civil defence engineers during annual building inspections and approval testing.
Keep clean testing logs and generate system test certificates after preventative maintenance rounds.
professions.summary: Meticulous Fire Alarm Technician with expertise in installing, addressing, programming, and maintaining life safety systems. Proficient in loop testing, smoke and heat detector calibration, and wiring fire-resistant FP200 cables to main panels. Thoroughly knowledgeable in cause-and-effect matrix programming and local Civil Defence regulatory compliance. Dedicated to conducting periodic battery tests, troubleshooting earth faults, and securing system handover approvals.

professions.name: Fire Fighting Technician
duties: Install, repair, and maintain wet pipe, dry pipe, pre-action, and deluge fire sprinkler networks.
Measure, groove, and fit fire mains using grooved mechanical couplings (Victaulic) and welded outlets.
Service and test diesel, electrical, and jockey fire pump sets to ensure prompt automatic start-up.
Conduct weekly fire pump churning tests, checking pressure relief valves, flow rates, and fuel levels.
Test water flow alarm switches, tamper switches on OS&Y gate valves, and pressure switches.
Inspect, pressure test, and flush internal fire hose reels, landing valves, and dry/wet riser breeching inlets.
Mount, inspect, and service portable fire extinguishers (CO2, foam, water, dry chemical powder).
Inspect clean agent fire suppression cylinders (FM-200, Novec 1230) for correct head pressures and weights.
Rectify water hammer issues, fix leaking pipe couplings, and rebuild corroded landing valves.
Assist external auditing agencies and civil defence officers during quarterly code compliance audits.
professions.summary: Safety-first Fire Fighting Technician proficient in installing, servicing, and inspecting wet, dry, and deluge fire suppression networks. Experienced in Victaulic grooved pipe jointing, fire hydrant flow testing, and rebuilding landing valves. Skilled in executing churning tests and routine maintenance on electrical, diesel, and jockey fire pump sets. Dedicated to ensuring complete operational readiness of fire protection equipment in compliance with Civil Defence codes.

professions.name: BMS Operator
duties: Monitor central BMS graphical user workstations, tracking real-time status of HVAC, lighting, and power.
Acknowledge, triage, and dispatch technicians immediately to high-priority equipment alarms.
Adjust temperature setpoints, run schedules, and occupancy timers to reduce building energy consumption.
Verify digital and analog I/O points between direct digital controllers (DDC) and field devices.
Track equipment running hours, initiate rotational duty/standby cycles, and flag maintenance needs.
Check communication status across field networks operating on BACnet, Modbus, and LonWorks.
Generate historical trend logs, energy consumption curves, and performance graphs for management.
Assist MEP engineers during testing and commissioning of automated dampers and VAV terminal units.
Report sensor calibration drift, abnormal delta-T values, and stuck actuator valves detected on graphics.
Maintain soft backups of BMS station databases, system graphic changes, and operator action logs.
professions.summary: Analytical Building Management System (BMS) Operator skilled in monitoring, controlling, and optimizing central building automation plants. Experienced in supervising HVAC equipment, electrical switchgear, and lighting controls via SCADA and DDC interfaces. Capable of analyzing trend logs, adjusting setpoints, and triaging high-priority equipment alarms to minimize energy waste. Detail-oriented professional committed to continuous plant visibility and rapid dispatching of field technicians.

professions.name: Facilities Maintenance Supervisor
duties: Lead, assign daily tasks, and supervise on-site teams of technicians, handymen, and trade helpers.
Manage work tickets through CAFM/CMMS software, ensuring closures within contractual SLA limits.
Conduct daily walk-throughs across facility common areas, plant rooms, and roofs to identify defects.
Monitor third-party specialized service contractors (elevators, pest control, facade cleaners) on site.
Review and approve Permit to Work (PTW) applications, risk assessments, and method statements.
Check consumption rates of engineering spare parts, tools, and consumables, raising store requisitions.
Verify technician execution of PPM (planned preventative maintenance) schedules on electrical and MEP assets.
Investigate repeat client complaints, attend tenant meetings, and implement corrective actions.
Ensure strict enforcement of safety regulations, personal protective equipment usage, and toolbox talks.
Prepare monthly facilities operational performance reports, utility track records, and incident summaries.
professions.summary: Organized Facilities Maintenance Supervisor with proven leadership in managing multi-disciplinary hard and soft FM operational teams. Expert in managing CAFM/CMMS work orders, monitoring service level agreements (SLAs), and conducting quality facility audits. Skilled in supervising external specialized contractors, issuing safe work permits (PTW), and controlling engineering spare parts. Dedicated to preserving property asset value, ensuring tenant satisfaction, and enforcing rigorous site safety standards.

professions.name: MEP Supervisor
duties: Oversee site execution of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing works according to approved drawings.
Coordinate with civil and structural supervisors to resolve spatial clashes prior to service installations.
Conduct morning toolbox safety talks and verify technicians are equipped with proper safety gear.
Raise Material Inspection Requests (MIR) and Work Inspection Requests (WIR) for consultant approvals.
Track installation progress against project master schedules and report delays to the MEP project engineer.
Inspect containment runs, pipe pressure tests, and duct leak checks before requesting official inspections.
Ensure installations strictly comply with DEWA, civil defence, and municipal engineering specifications.
Conduct site snagging, prepare internal defect punch lists, and supervise trade teams until de-snagged.
Mark red-line revisions on approved shop drawings to assist draftsmen in creating accurate as-built drawings.
Monitor storage conditions, material staging, and safe handling of delivered MEP equipment on site.
professions.summary: Results-oriented MEP Supervisor with comprehensive experience overseeing mechanical, electrical, and plumbing engineering execution on-site. Proficient in reading coordinated drawings, tracking construction milestones, and resolving inter-trade spatial clashes. Experienced in raising Work Inspection Requests (WIR), monitoring material staging, and delivering daily toolbox talks. Committed to delivering MEP installations on schedule, within quality benchmarks, and aligned with local utility standards.

professions.name: Maintenance Foreman
duties: Distribute daily work tickets and planned maintenance orders directly to technicians and helpers.
Conduct hands-on inspections of completed plumbing, electrical, and HVAC tasks to verify repair quality.
Lead troubleshooting on complex mechanical or electrical breakdowns that field technicians cannot solve.
Inspect tools, ladders, diagnostic meters, and safety equipment daily for damage or calibration expiry.
Manage technician shift rotas, overtime schedules, emergency on-call rotas, and leave planning.
Verify material requisitions and ensure spare parts pulled from stores match the equipment specifications.
Conduct daily morning briefings and tool-box talks reinforcing safe working practices and PPE rules.
Sign off on completed maintenance job cards before submitting them to the facilities supervisor.
Coordinate handover notes between outgoing and incoming shifts to ensure continuity of ongoing repairs.
Act as the primary on-ground responder to emergency maintenance calls like major pipe bursts or outages.
professions.summary: Hands-on Maintenance Foreman skilled in directing technician teams, allocating daily job tickets, and supervising field repair works. Experienced in practical troubleshooting across electrical distributions, plumbing networks, and central HVAC assets. Strong track record in inspecting tool conditions, verifying spare parts usage, and managing technician shift rotations. Dedicated to maintaining high first-time-fix rates and ensuring swift containment during emergency property outages.

professions.name: Generator Technician
duties: Perform periodic maintenance on standby and prime diesel generators (oil changes, fuel, and air filter swaps).
Inspect, test, and maintain Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS) to ensure seamless changeover during grid failure.
Test starter battery banks, record specific gravity of electrolyte, check chargers, and clean corroded terminals.
Troubleshoot fuel delivery systems, bleeds air from injector lines, and services mechanical/electronic injectors.
Connect and monitor mobile resistive load bank units during annual generator full-load certification tests.
Calibrate electronic engine governors, digital controller settings, and engine safety shut-off parameters.
Inspect engine cooling radiators, check belt tensions, test coolant freeze points, and replace worn water pumps.
Check alternator insulation resistance, clean slip rings, and troubleshoot automatic voltage regulators (AVR).
Keep fuel day tanks clean, monitor bulk fuel levels, and test fuel polishing systems for water contamination.
Maintain detailed runtime logs, fuel consumption records, and diagnostic fault codes for compliance audits.
professions.summary: Skilled Generator Technician specializing in the preventative maintenance, overhaul, and testing of prime and standby diesel generator sets. Proficient in troubleshooting heavy diesel fuel systems, mechanical injectors, automatic voltage regulators, and alternator windings. Experienced in servicing automatic transfer switches (ATS) and executing annual resistive load bank certification procedures. Committed to ensuring 100% emergency power reliability through regular battery bank and engine health audits.

professions.name: Swimming Pool Maintenance Technician
duties: Test pool water samples twice daily for free chlorine, combined chlorine, pH, total alkalinity, and cyanuric acid.
Calculate, dose, and balance pool chemicals (chlorine granules, liquid sodium hypochlorite, muriatic acid, soda ash).
Backwash, rinse, and service multi-port sand filters, cartridge filters, and diatomaceous earth (DE) systems.
Vacuum pool floors, skim floating debris, brush tile waterlines, and clear skimmer/strainer baskets.
Inspect, service, and rebuild chemical dosing pumps, peristaltic tubes, and pH/ORP automated controllers.
Troubleshoot main pool circulation pumps, lubricate motor bearings, and replace worn mechanical shaft seals.
Inspect pool heat pumps and chiller units to ensure regulated water temperatures according to season.
Check underwater pool light fittings, niche seals, and 12V safety isolation transformers for electrical faults.
Shock pool water with high-dose oxidizers to treat algae blooms, cloudiness, or biological contamination.
Maintain daily pool logbooks tracking test readings, chemical usage, and municipal health approvals.
professions.summary: Diligent Swimming Pool Maintenance Technician experienced in commercial pool water chemistry balancing, filtration, and sanitization. Proficient in daily water testing, automated chemical dosing pump calibration, and sand filter backwashing operations. Skilled in servicing main pool circulation pumps, underwater LED lighting, and seasonal pool heat-chiller systems. Dedicated to upholding strict municipal public health standards to provide safe and pristine recreational water conditions.

professions.name: Handyman
duties: Patch and repair holes, dents, and cracks in drywall partitions using joint compound and sanders.
Paint interior walls, doors, skirting boards, and ceilings using brushes, rollers, and touch-up paint.
Assemble, disassemble, move, and repair flat-pack office furniture, desks, hinges, and cabinets.
Replace faulty door locks, barrel cylinders, hinges, overhead door closers, and handles.
Fix leaking faucets, clear minor sink clogs, replace flexible water hoses, and fix toilet cistern flush kits.
Strip old, mouldy sealant and apply fresh neat lines of silicone around sinks, bathtubs, and kitchen counters.
Mount televisions, projector brackets, whiteboards, picture frames, and mirrors securely onto masonry or stud walls.
Replace blown incandescent, halogen, and plug-in LED light bulbs, diffusers, and emergency exit sign covers.
Repair loose ceramic tiles, regrout bathroom floor joints, and fix chipped baseboards.
Carry out daily minor property maintenance walk-throughs and log completed jobs with building management.
professions.summary: Versatile and resourceful Handyman with broad expertise in resolving residential and commercial general property maintenance issues. Skilled in minor carpentry repairs, interior wall patching, silicone bead sealing, and hanging door hardware and locks. Capable of addressing minor plumbing leaks, replacing sanitary fittings, and swapping faulty electrical lamps and switches. Customer-centric worker committed to providing rapid, clean, and visually seamless repairs across client properties.

professions.name: CCTV Control Room Operator
duties: Monitor live feeds from surveillance cameras across all zones via multi-screen video control room displays.
Direct mobile security guards and patrolling units via two-way radios to investigate perimeter breaches or alarms.
Acknowledge and cross-reference intrusion alarms, fire panel alarms, and emergency exit activations on CCTV.
Review, extract, and export recorded security footage for management or Dubai Police / SIRA inquiries.
Check video storage servers, hard disk retention limits, camera uptime, and report offline units immediately.
Control remote PTZ (Pan-Tilt-Zoom) cameras to track suspicious individuals, trespassers, or vehicles on site.
Record all notable occurrences, system alerts, operational handovers, and guard communications in the daily log.
Coordinate with mall/building security teams during VIP arrivals, crowd surges, or emergency evacuations.
Enforce strict control room access policies, ensuring no unauthorized personnel enter or view live screens.
Run daily functional audits of control room emergency panels, panic buttons, and direct telecom links.
professions.summary: Alert and methodical CCTV Control Room Operator experienced in operating high-density video monitoring stations and surveillance suites. Proficient in utilizing video management software (VMS), controlling PTZ tracking, and cross-referencing alarm inputs. Skilled in incident dispatching, recording chronological shift logs, and exporting video footage for authority investigations. Dedicated to enforcing stringent data security protocols and maintaining uncompromised vigilance across facility grounds.

professions.name: Security Supervisor
duties: Plan, allocate, and monitor the daily deployment of security officers across static posts and patrol routes.
Conduct shift change parades to inspect uniforms, grooming, guard licenses (SIRA/PSBD), and equipment.
Conduct spot inspections across guard posts to verify vigilance, alertness, and proper logbook maintenance.
Lead the on-scene response to major security breaches, thefts, violent altercations, or accidents on site.
Act as the primary liaison between facility managers, event coordinators, clients, and local police.
Conduct regular site emergency response drills, fire evacuation simulations, and bomb-threat briefings.
Prepare detailed, factual security incident reports complete with timelines, evidence, and witness notes.
Train newly deployed security officers on client-specific site layout, SOPs, access rules, and post orders.
Manage shift handovers, review key registers, visitor counts, and lost-and-found ledgers.
Enforce disciplinary standards and performance reviews for security personnel failing to meet operational standards.
professions.summary: Authoritative and disciplined Security Supervisor skilled in managing guard rotations, daily shift parades, and site security deployments. Proficient in auditing static posts, inspecting logbooks, leading emergency evacuation drills, and managing client security relations. Expert in enforcing SIRA regulations, conducting threat risk assessments, and authoring factual incident investigation reports. Dedicated to mentoring security teams, ensuring strict post compliance, and mitigating site vulnerability risks.

professions.name: Patrolling Guard
duties: Conduct scheduled and random foot patrols across buildings, perimeters, corridors, and basements.
Clock in at designated checkpoints on time using digital RFID patrol wands or electronic guard tour systems.
Check and confirm that all perimeter gates, emergency fire doors, roof access hatches, and plant rooms are locked.
Identify and report property maintenance hazards such as water leaks, broken light fittings, or blocked exits.
Challenge unknown or unbadged individuals found loitering in restricted, private, or off-limits areas.
Monitor parked vehicles for unauthorized parking, broken windows, open doors, or suspicious contents.
Provide visual deterrence against vandalism, theft, loitering, and anti-social behavior on client premises.
Communicate routine status updates and perimeter clear signals to the central control room via two-way radio.
Assist visitors, lost customers, or tenants with directions and access assistance in a professional manner.
Hand over accurate post observations, incident notes, and gate key sets at the conclusion of every shift.
professions.summary: Vigilant and physically active Patrolling Guard experienced in securing large-scale commercial premises, compounds, and residential towers. Skilled in operating electronic guard tour verification wands, inspecting remote perimeter fencing, and verifying locked access doors. Proactive in identifying environmental hazards, water leaks, unlatched windows, and suspicious loitering individuals. Committed to clear two-way radio reporting and maintaining a strong deterrent presence on ground shifts.

professions.name: Bouncer
duties: Verify legal age, identity documents, dress codes, and tickets at venue or event entry points.
Conduct respectful body and bag searches to prevent weapons, drugs, outside alcohol, and banned items from entering.
Monitor venue floor capacity, regulate door queues, and manage entry flow to prevent dangerous crushing.
Observe patrons on the floor, identifying signs of aggressive behavior, excessive intoxication, or harassment.
Step in promptly to verbally calm agitated guests before confrontations escalate into physical fights.
Eject disruptive, combative, or non-compliant individuals safely from the premises following legal guidelines.
Protect venue employees, musicians, DJs, and bar staff from abusive or intrusive customer behavior.
Escort VIP guests safely through crowded areas, backstage pathways, and vehicle departure lanes.
Keep emergency exit passages, panic hardware doors, and fire staircases unobstructed by patrons at all times.
Coordinate with local authorities and emergency medical responders if patrons suffer injuries or overdose.
professions.summary: Composed and physically capable Venue Security Officer and Bouncer experienced in crowd control and nightlife security management. Highly skilled in ID verification, legal age screening, bag checks, and queue management to prevent bottleneck hazards. Adept at defusing verbal confrontations diplomatically and applying compliant physical interventions only when strictly necessary. Dedicated to protecting staff, escorting VIP patrons, and keeping emergency escape routes accessible at all times.

professions.name: Access Control Technician
duties: Install and wire electromagnetic locks (maglocks), electric strikes, drop bolts, and exit push buttons.
Run, terminate, and test RS-485, Wiegand, and TCP/IP cables connecting door hardware to sub-controllers.
Mount and configure biometric devices (fingerprint, facial recognition) and RFID proximity card readers.
Set up and commission network-based access control panels (ACPs), power supplies, and battery backups.
Configure door access software, program reader zones, set time profiles, and assign access permissions.
Install and maintain automated turnstiles, optical speed gates, and perimeter road boom barriers.
Interface access control panels with fire alarm outputs to achieve automatic, fail-safe door unlocks.
Troubleshoot communication drops, faulty door contact sensors, reader errors, and ground loop faults.
Replace worn hardware including hinges, armature plates, door loops, and request-to-exit infrared sensors.
Assist IT and security teams in issuing cards, setting up database backups, and running audit access logs.
professions.summary: Technical Access Control Specialist experienced in installing, wiring, and commissioning physical security and door automation systems. Proficient in terminating maglocks, electric strikes, push buttons, card readers, and biometric facial recognition terminals. Skilled in programming access control software, setting permissions, and integrating access panels with fire alarm releases. Committed to delivering seamless, fail-safe door security networks with minimal network communication downtime.

professions.name: HSE Officer
duties: Perform daily safety inspections across project sites to detect unsafe working conditions and unsafe behaviors.
Review and enforce site Permit to Work (PTW) protocols for hot work, confined space, and working at height.
Conduct mandatory morning toolbox talks to educate workers on site-specific hazards and control measures.
Verify that all laborers and trade craftsmen are equipped with and correctly wearing required PPE.
Investigate accidents, injuries, and near-miss incidents, establishing root causes and corrective measures.
Ensure portable fire fighting equipment, eye-wash stations, and first aid kits are accessible and inspected.
Verify validity of third-party operator certificates and machinery fitness test cards (cranes, hoists, scaffolding).
Inspect scaffolds, guardrails, ladders, and edge protection systems before issuing green safe-to-use tags.
Monitor chemical storage areas, ensuring presence of valid safety data sheets (SDS) and spill kits.
Compile monthly HSE performance records, incident frequency rates, and safety statistics for leadership.
professions.summary: Proactive Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) Officer with expertise in hazard identification, risk assessment, and site auditing. Skilled in enforcing Permit to Work (PTW) protocols for hot work, height access, and confined spaces across active operations. Passionate about safety culture development through regular toolbox talks, emergency drill execution, and incident investigations. Dedicated to ensuring complete alignment with corporate environmental safety guidelines and local municipal regulations.

professions.name: Safety Marshall
duties: Guide heavy construction vehicles, delivery trucks, and mobile plant safely through site entrance gates.
Direct pedestrian walkways on active sites, keeping foot traffic clear of moving machinery and suspended loads.
Patrol designated work zones to verify all site workers wear high-visibility vests, hard hats, and steel-toe boots.
Flag unsafe conditions like uncovered floor penetrations, missing handrails, or water pooling near live cables.
Direct workers to assembly points quickly and calmly during emergency evacuation alarms and fire drills.
Check that site emergency escape routes, stairs, and assembly areas remain completely clear of stored materials.
Stop unauthorized workers from entering restricted zones such as deep excavations or confined spaces.
Assist HSE officers during morning safety inductions, toolbox talks, and headcount verifications.
Report minor safety infractions, near misses, and defective safety barricades immediately over the two-way radio.
Ensure spill kits, eye-wash stations, and temporary muster point signage are correctly placed and visible.
professions.summary: Dedicated Safety Marshall skilled in controlling site logistics, regulating personnel movement, and maintaining safe traffic corridors. Experienced in guiding heavy plant machinery, directing dump trucks, and segregating pedestrian pathways from hazard zones. Proactive in auditing site PPE compliance, reporting uncovered penetrations, and maintaining accessible emergency assembly areas. Committed to rapid evacuation marshaling and real-time incident escalation to site HSE teams.

professions.name: Lifeguard
duties: Maintain active, continuous visual surveillance over pool or beach zones using structured scanning patterns.
Enforce pool and beach safety regulations firmly to prevent dangerous horseplay, running, or improper diving.
Identify swimmers in distress quickly and execute immediate in-water rescue techniques to bring them to safety.
Perform cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) and deploy Automated External Defibrillators (AED) in emergencies.
Provide prompt first aid for minor cuts, slips, heat exhaustion, jellyfish stings, and drowning symptoms.
Secure suspected spinal injury victims in the water using backboards and neck collars prior to paramedic arrival.
Inspect rescue tubes, spinal boards, throw bags, and oxygen cylinders daily to verify readiness.
Check water depth markers, warning flags, pool drain covers, and lane lines for safety compliance.
Advise bathers on sun safety, current rip tides, weather changes, and deep water boundary restrictions.
Document all incidents, medical assists, and daily facility safety inspections in the operational logbook.
professions.summary: Attentive and certified Lifeguard with strong swimming proficiency and life-saving capabilities across aquatic and beachfront facilities. Expert in active water surveillance, hazard prevention, patron supervision, and enforcing pool safety guidelines firmly. Highly trained in executing in-water victim extractions, CPR/AED deployment, and emergency first-aid administration. Dedicated to maintaining clean pool environments, inspecting rescue equipment daily, and preventing aquatic accidents.

professions.name: Dental Assistant
duties: Sterilize, disinfect, and pack dental instruments using ultrasonic baths, pouches, and autoclaves.
Seat patients comfortably, confirm appointments, and prepare the dental operatory with required sterile instrument trays.
Practice four-handed dentistry, passing handpieces, burs, probes, and mirrors smoothly to the dentist.
Operate high-volume evacuators, saliva ejectors, and air-water syringes to keep the oral field clear and dry.
Position dental intraoral X-ray sensors, expose bitewings or periapicals, and mount digital radiographs.
Mix dental restoration materials, cements, liners, composite bonding agents, and alginate impression pastes.
Instruct patients on post-treatment dental care, oral hygiene techniques, and temporary filling precautions.
Disinfect dental chair surfaces, suction lines, water units, and light handles between patient appointments.
Track clinical consumables inventory, checking expiry dates on composites, anesthetics, and impression materials.
Update electronic dental records, chart treatment notes dictated by the dentist, and schedule follow-ups.
professions.summary: Organized and detail-focused Dental Assistant experienced in delivering efficient chairside support across clinical dental practices. Skilled in four-handed dentistry, dental material mixing, instrument sterilization via autoclaves, and exposing digital X-rays. Empathetic caregiver dedicated to calming anxious patients, providing post-operative instructions, and maintaining sterile operatory rooms. Thorough in managing clinical instrument inventory, logging patient charting notes, and assisting dental practitioners.

professions.name: Home Care Nurse
duties: Travel to patients' residences to deliver specialized, one-on-one nursing care according to physician care plans.
Measure and record vital signs, blood glucose levels, and oxygen saturation during each home visit.
Clean, debride, and dress chronic wounds, surgical incisions, and pressure ulcers using aseptic techniques.
Administer oral medications, subcutaneous injections, and manage intravenous infusions at the bedside.
Manage and flush urinary catheters, stoma bags, tracheostomy tubes, and enteral feeding tubes (PEG/NG).
Assist bedridden or frail patients with repositioning, transfer techniques, and gentle range-of-motion exercises.
Recognize and respond to acute clinical deteriorations by calling emergency services and notifying doctors.
Guide family members and domestic helpers on safe patient transfers, fall prevention, and nutritional needs.
Maintain sterile storage and disposal of clinical waste and used sharps inside the home environment.
Complete electronic clinical visit documentation and progress notes in compliance with DHA/MOH home care policies.
professions.summary: Patient-centered Home Care Nurse experienced in delivering specialized, compassionate medical support directly to residential patients. Proficient in chronic wound debridement, sterile dressing, vital sign tracking, and subcutaneous or IV medication delivery. Skilled in managing medical equipment such as feeding tubes, tracheostomies, urinary catheters, and oxygen concentrators. Dedicated to educating family caregivers, fostering patient independence, and following strict home health clinical standards.

professions.name: Phlebotomist
duties: Verify patient identity using two primary identifiers before starting any blood collection procedure.
Palpate veins in the antecubital fossa to select the safest and most accessible puncture site.
Perform aseptic venipunctures using appropriate gauge needles, butterfly sets, or lancets for capillary draws.
Draw blood into correct color-coded vacuum tubes (EDTA, SST, Heparin, Citrate) following the order of draw.
Label specimen collection tubes immediately at the patient’s side with barcodes, timestamps, and patient details.
Invert collection tubes gently the specified number of times to mix additives properly and prevent micro-clots.
Manage post-draw site care, apply pressure dressings, and treat patients experiencing vasovagal syncope or fainting.
Spin and separate serum or plasma samples using laboratory centrifuges under prescribed speeds and temperatures.
Package and store specimens at correct temperatures (refrigerated, frozen, or ambient) for transport to the lab.
Dispose of used needles and blood-contaminated materials into biohazard sharps containers immediately after use.
professions.summary: Precision-oriented Phlebotomist with expertise in drawing clinical blood specimens across adult, geriatric, and pediatric patients. Skilled in vein palpation, aseptic venipuncture techniques, correct vacutainer tube selection, and inverted sample mixing. Committed to patient safety, strict barcode labeling accuracy, infection control, and minimizing patient discomfort. Experienced in processing blood samples via laboratory centrifuges and coordinating rapid temperature-controlled specimen transfers.

professions.name: Medical Laboratory Technician
duties: Receive, check, and log biological specimens (blood, urine, sputum, tissue) against electronic test orders.
Operate, calibrate, and run daily quality control samples on automated hematology and biochemistry analyzers.
Prepare, fix, and stain peripheral blood smears and microbiological slides using Gram stain or Giemsa techniques.
Examine urine sediments, stools, and bodily fluids under optical microscopes to identify cells, casts, or parasites.
Inoculate agar plates and broth media with clinical swabs to isolate and culture pathogenic bacteria.
Verify abnormal test findings, rerun suspicious samples, and flag critical test results to lab pathologists.
Prepare standard chemical solutions, dilutions, reagents, and buffers following standard laboratory protocols.
Maintain automated lab equipment, clean sample probes, replace waste lines, and run cleaning cycles.
Comply with biosafety level (BSL) regulations, handling hazardous infectious materials in biological safety cabinets.
Document internal quality audits, analyzer error codes, reagent batch numbers, and ambient fridge temperatures.
professions.summary: Analytical Medical Laboratory Technician proficient in executing clinical diagnostic testing across hematology, biochemistry, and microbiology. Skilled in operating automated clinical analyzers, staining specimen slides, preparing chemical reagents, and performing urinalysis. Rigorous in running daily quality control assays, calibrating lab instruments, and identifying specimen anomalies. Committed to upholding biosafety standards, ensuring testing accuracy, and reporting critical findings to pathologists quickly.

professions.name: Radiology Technician
duties: Review physician imaging orders, verify patient identity, and screen female patients for possible pregnancy.
Position patients accurately on the examination table or bucky stand to obtain required radiographic views.
Adjust exposure factors (kVp, mAs) on digital X-ray machines based on anatomical density and patient body mass.
Apply lead aprons, thyroid shields, and gonadal protectors to limit unnecessary radiation exposure to patients.
Operate digital radiography (DR) and computed radiography (CR) systems to acquire and process image data.
Critique captured X-rays for proper positioning, contrast, exposure, and absence of motion artifacts.
Transfer completed diagnostic images to the Picture Archiving and Communication System (PACS) for radiologist review.
Assist radiologists during contrast studies or fluoroscopic procedures, preparing non-ionic contrast media.
Disinfect examination tables, positioning sponges, and detector plates after every patient exam.
Perform routine equipment checks, verify collimator light alignment, and log radiation dosimeter readings.
professions.summary: Certified Radiology Technician with comprehensive expertise in performing diagnostic digital radiography across varied clinical settings. Proficient in accurate patient anatomical positioning, adjusting technical exposure parameters, and enforcing ALARA radiation safety. Experienced in uploading imaging studies to PACS networks, maintaining equipment calibration, and assisting with contrast exams. Empathetic communicator focused on patient comfort, protection of sensitive anatomy, and high-clarity diagnostic imagery.

professions.name: Physiotherapy Assistant
duties: Prepare treatment cubicles, clean plinths, and lay out clean linens, towels, and resistance bands for therapy sessions.
Assist patients onto examination tables and position them comfortably for targeted physical therapy routines.
Apply superficial thermal agents including hot moist packs, hydrocollators, and cold gel ice packs to muscles.
Set up and apply electrotherapy equipment such as TENS, interferential therapy (IFT), and therapeutic ultrasound.
Guide patients through prescribed stretching, strengthening, balance, and range-of-motion exercise plans.
Assist patients during gait training using walking frames, crutches, parallel bars, and quad canes.
Monitor patient physical tolerance, pain reactions, and vital signs during active rehabilitation exercises.
Sanitize exercise balls, gym machines, weights, and therapy surfaces between consecutive patient sessions.
Transport wheelchair and mobility-impaired patients safely between hospital wards and the physiotherapy gym.
Report patient exercise adherence, pain scale changes, and session outcomes directly to the lead physiotherapist.
professions.summary: Energetic Physiotherapy Assistant experienced in rehabilitating patients recovering from orthopedic injuries, strokes, or surgical interventions. Skilled in guiding patients through prescribed therapeutic exercises, gait training, and applying electrotherapy and heat packs. Attentive to patient physical responses, recording progress indicators, and sanitizing clinical treatment tables between sessions. Committed to motivating patients, assisting safe mobility transfers, and working collaboratively under senior physiotherapist direction.

professions.name: Pharmacy Assistant
duties: Receive prescriptions from patients, check customer insurance cards, and enter orders into pharmacy software.
Locate, count, pick, and package prescribed medications and dosage forms under the direct supervision of a pharmacist.
Apply printed prescription labels displaying dosage instructions, cautionary stickers, and patient names on boxes.
Monitor and log daily pharmacy refrigerator temperatures to preserve vaccines, insulins, and biologicals.
Receive medication deliveries from pharmaceutical distributors, check invoice quantities, and unpack supplies.
Stock retail shelves, arrange medications systematically by pharmacological class or alphabetically, and face items.
Audit inventory regularly to identify, pull, and segregate products nearing their expiration dates within 3 to 6 months.
Process retail sales transactions, operate POS cash registers, and handle credit card or insurance co-payments.
Answer incoming pharmacy phone inquiries regarding over-the-counter stock availability and store opening hours.
Maintain cleanliness and hygiene across medicine dispensing counters, tablet counting trays, and storage bays.
professions.summary: Detail-oriented Pharmacy Assistant skilled in supporting registered pharmacists within high-volume retail and clinical environments. Experienced in picking and packaging prescription medications, verifying dosage labels, and managing point-of-sale customer checkouts. Proficient in tracking cold chain vaccine refrigeration temperatures, restocking shelves systematically, and removing expired pharmaceuticals. Committed to patient confidentiality, excellent customer service, and ensuring safe, compliant medication handling.

professions.name: Medical Orderly
duties: Transfer patients safely between wards, triage, operating rooms, radiology suites, and discharge areas.
Operate and steer hospital beds, stretchers, wheelchairs, and recovery trollies safely through busy corridors.
Assist nursing staff with lifting, rolling, and repositioning immobilized or bariatric patients in hospital beds.
Transport laboratory specimens, blood units, biopsy samples, and pathology slides directly to testing labs.
Collect and deliver prescribed medication orders and urgent supplies from the central hospital pharmacy to wards.
Move and secure heavy medical gas cylinders (oxygen, nitrous oxide) using dedicated cylinder transport trollies.
Strip used bedding, package contaminated linens in water-soluble laundry bags, and make beds with clean linens.
Clean and disinfect wheelchairs, stretchers, IV poles, and transport equipment using approved hospital wipes.
Assist clinical teams by running urgent errands, fetching crash carts, or transferring documents during medical codes.
Assist in handling, transferring, and respectful transport of deceased patients to the hospital mortuary facility.
professions.summary: Supportive and dependable Medical Orderly experienced in facilitating inpatient mobility and logistical care across hospital facilities. Skilled in transporting patients safely using wheelchairs, gurneys, and hospital beds for diagnostic testing and room transfers. Adept at moving heavy medical gas cylinders, restocking clean ward linens, and delivering urgent lab specimens safely. Dedicated to practicing strict infection control, sanitizing transfer gear, and delivering compassionate, respectful patient handling.

professions.name: Site Supervisor
duties: Direct day-to-day operations on the construction site, assigning tasks to trade crews and sub-contractors.
Read and enforce structural and architectural blueprints to ensure works match approved project designs.
Coordinate with MEP, civil, and finishing supervisors to resolve space conflicts and scheduling bottlenecks.
Inspect incoming construction materials to verify quality, batch numbers, and conformance to approved specifications.
Track daily progress against planned targets and update the site project engineer on milestones and delays.
Conduct site inspections before requesting formal consultant sign-offs (Work Inspection Requests / WIR).
Enforce company HSE standards, ensuring trade teams wear required safety equipment and work securely.
Monitor material consumption to minimize waste, breakage, and unauthorized off-site movement.
Verify that proper curing, backfilling, and structural testing procedures are carried out on schedule.
Prepare daily site logs tracking manpower headcounts, active plant machinery, weather delays, and work finished.
professions.summary: Proactive Construction Site Supervisor experienced in coordinating structural and civil site operations to achieve scheduled project milestones. Skilled in interpreting architectural blueprints, assigning tasks to trade subcontractors, and managing material consumption rates. Proficient in conducting quality inspections, raising Work Inspection Requests (WIR), and enforcing site health and safety standards. Clear communicator dedicated to resolving inter-trade construction delays and maintaining comprehensive daily site work logs.

professions.name: Finishing Supervisor
duties: Supervise internal and external finishing operations including tiling, painting, false ceiling, and joinery.
Review finishing detail drawings to verify floor patterns, ceiling datum levels, and wall cladding layouts.
Check substrate preparation, plaster plumbness, and waterproofing application before finishing layers are applied.
Inspect tile layouts for uniform joints, hollow-free bedding, lippage control, and accurate slope to drains.
Inspect painted surfaces with raking lights to detect roller marks, patchy finishes, pinholes, and cracks.
Check the installation of wooden doors, frames, ironmongery, and built-in wardrobes for true alignment and swing.
Prepare detailed internal snag lists (punch lists) and supervise craftsmen until all defects are cleared.
Coordinate material handovers from site stores, ensuring correct tiles, paints, and adhesives are distributed.
Ensure protective coverings (corrugated sheets, masking tape) remain intact on completed floors and surfaces.
Assist the project engineer during final consultant and client handovers to secure zero-defect approvals.
professions.summary: Detail-driven Finishing Supervisor specialized in delivering high-end architectural, interior fit-out, and surface finishing works. Expert in inspecting floor tiling, wall painting, drywall partitions, suspended ceilings, and architectural wood joinery. Skilled in coordinating multi-trade finishing sequences, developing rigorous defect punch lists, and expediting de-snagging tasks. Focused on material wastage reduction, precise finish alignment, and securing swift client and consultant handover sign-offs.

professions.name: Land Surveyor
duties: Establish site survey control points and reference benchmarks using GNSS receivers and high-precision total stations.
Carry out site setting-out, transferring architectural coordinates, column grids, and boundary lines to the ground.
Establish accurate benchmark transfer points (TBM) across building floor slabs using digital auto levels.
Conduct topographic surveys of existing ground profiles, calculating cut-and-fill earthwork quantities.
Check verticality (plumb) of tall reinforced concrete columns, shear walls, and structural steel elements.
Record as-built coordinates and elevations of completed pipelines, manholes, road corridors, and foundations.
Download raw survey field data into CAD software to prepare contour maps, profiles, and coordinate sheets.
Verify plot boundaries, road centerlines, and setback limits against official Dubai Municipality or master developer plans.
Calibrate, clean, and run field collimation checks on optical and electronic surveying instruments regularly.
Work closely with structural engineers and earthwork contractors to monitor site settlement and ground shifts.
professions.summary: Precision-oriented Land Surveyor with extensive experience in executing setting-out and topographic surveying for civil infrastructure. Expert in operating electronic total stations, GNSS GPS receivers, and digital auto levels to establish site reference grids. Skilled in processing raw survey data into AutoCAD drawing layers, checking structural plumbness, and verifying plot boundaries. Committed to measurement accuracy, calculating cut-and-fill earthwork quantities, and maintaining survey instrument calibrations.

professions.name: Civil Draftsman
duties: Produce detailed structural and civil shop drawings from engineer sketches and structural calculations.
Draft foundation layouts, column plans, slab reinforcement sections, and beam profiles using AutoCAD.
Generate comprehensive Bar Bending Schedules (BBS) detailing rebar cut lengths, bend shapes, and weights.
Incorporate MEP openings, sleeve locations, and pipe drops into structural drawings to avoid site clashes.
Update and revise working drawings according to engineer mark-ups, site RFIs, and consultant comments.
Convert site survey coordinate point tables into clear site layout plans and road alignment sheets.
Prepare comprehensive as-built drawing packages reflecting completed on-site conditions for final handovers.
Ensure drawing title blocks, line weights, layers, and text fonts conform to company and client drafting standards.
Cross-check dimensions and coordinate grids across architectural, structural, and civil drawings for discrepancies.
Manage digital drawing archives, track revision numbers, and distribute approved drawing prints to site teams.
professions.summary: Technical Civil Draftsman proficient in converting structural design concepts into comprehensive, fully detailed construction shop drawings. Highly skilled in AutoCAD, drafting foundation plans, reinforced concrete layouts, bar bending schedules, and drainage routes. Experienced in incorporating MEP openings to eliminate structural clashes and updating red-line site markups into accurate as-builts. Dedicated to maintaining consistent CAD drafting layer standards, accurate scale conversions, and timely drawing submittals.

professions.name: Mechanical Draftsman
duties: Draft detailed HVAC ductwork and piping layouts based on mechanical design calculations and space constraints.
Produce coordinated MEP shop drawings integrating ductwork, chilled water lines, plumbing, and fire mains.
Prepare single-line and double-line pipe routing drawings, valve stations, and equipment room layouts.
Draw plumbing drainage slope profiles, riser diagrams, cleanout locations, and water supply schematics.
Create isometric drawings of plant rooms, pump connections, and chiller manifolds for site fabrication.
Convert engineer calculations into duct size dimensions, indicating air flow rates, CFM, and damper locations.
Prepare detailed sectional views showing duct and pipe clearances beneath beams and false ceilings.
Revise mechanical drawings based on consultant review comments and update red-line markups into as-builts.
Assist estimation teams by measuring material take-offs (linear pipe runs, duct surface areas) from CAD drawings.
Maintain organized drawing logs, track submittal reference numbers, and prepare plot files for site issuance.
professions.summary: Detail-oriented Mechanical Draftsman with comprehensive experience in producing coordinated MEP, HVAC, and piping shop drawings. Proficient in AutoCAD and Revit MEP, detailing ductwork routes, plant room equipment layouts, and piping isometric spools. Skilled in extracting accurate material take-offs, detailing structural ceiling clearances, and revising submittals to meet consultant remarks. Committed to coordinating with civil and electrical services to deliver clash-free, constructible engineering schematics.

professions.name: Shuttering Carpenter
duties: Measure, cut, and assemble timber formwork and marine plywood for concrete foundations, columns, and slabs.
Erect system formwork (Doka, Peri) and conventional timber shuttering following structural layout plans.
Set and adjust telescopic steel props, acrow jacks, and ledger frames to support slab decking at correct heights.
Check formwork dimensions, level, squareness, and plumb using spirit levels, plumb bobs, and measuring tapes.
Drill holes and install tie rods, PVC sleeves, and cone spacers to hold opposing column and wall shutters securely.
Apply form-release shuttering oil evenly across plywood surfaces prior to concrete pouring for smooth demolding.
Seal formwork joints, corners, and gaps with foam tape to prevent grout leakage during concrete vibration.
Install timber kickers, chamfer strips, and stop-ends for construction joints according to engineer instructions.
Strip and dismantle formwork safely after concrete curing periods without damaging structural corners or faces.
Clean, scrape residual concrete off plywood panels, oil surfaces, and stack reusable components neatly for reuse.
professions.summary: Skilled Shuttering Carpenter experienced in constructing, erecting, and dismantling timber and system formwork on concrete projects. Proficient in measuring, cutting marine plywood, setting up adjustable steel props, and securing tie-rod systems for slabs and walls. Expert in reading structural plans, aligning formwork plumb and level, and applying form-release oils to ensure smooth demolding. Dedicated to formwork structural rigidity during concrete pours and maintaining strict on-site safety standards.

professions.name: Finishing Carpenter
duties: Fit, hang, and balance solid core and hollow core wooden doors into pre-installed door jambs and frames.
Measure, cut, and join timber skirting boards, picture rails, and decorative wall panel trims.
Cut precise 45-degree mitre joints for door architraves, cornices, and baseboards using powered mitre saws.
Install door ironmongery, including mortise locks, euro cylinders, handles, pull plates, and overhead door closers.
Adjust concealed European-style hinges and sliding track rollers to achieve consistent door gaps and smooth action.
Install wooden handrails, decorative timber slats, and balustrade elements along staircases and mezzanines.
Sand down timber surfaces, joints, and wooden trims using electric orbit sanders to prepare them for lacquer or paint.
Fill nail holes, joint seams, and wood imperfections with matching wood filler and touch-up wax sticks.
Check wall plumb and level before scribing panels to fit tightly against uneven plaster or tile surfaces.
Keep delicate timber finishes protected during secondary site activities by applying protective tape and plastic wrap.
professions.summary: Meticulous Finishing Carpenter experienced in installing high-end architectural joinery, timber trims, and fine wooden fixtures. Expert in hanging solid-core doors, fitting mortise ironmongery, and cutting accurate 45-degree mitre joints for architraves and skirting. Skilled in adjusting concealed hinges, mounting wall paneling, and repairing surface veneer blemishes using specialty fillers. Committed to precision craftsmanship, maintaining tight hairline wood joints, and protecting delicate installed finishes.

professions.name: Furniture Carpenter
duties: Assemble modular cabinets, wardrobes, kitchen counters, and vanity units using cam-locks, dowels, and screws.
Cut, trim, and bond plastic laminates and natural veneers onto MDF or plywood substrates using contact adhesive.
Apply PVC and veneer edge banding to exposed board edges using manual edge banders or edge-ironing tools.
Machine wood joints, grooves, dados, and rebates using hand routers, table saws, and biscuit joiners.
Install undermount and ball-bearing drawer runner slides, ensuring parallel alignment and smooth soft-close movement.
Fasten built-in cabinetry securely to masonry walls using appropriate rawlplugs, angle brackets, and heavy-duty screws.
Cut out countertop openings for kitchen sinks, drop-in cooktops, and under-counter electrical wire grommets.
Adjust cabinet doors, gaps, and lift-up hydraulic stays to achieve uniform reveal lines across entire kitchen runs.
Repair scratched, gouged, or chipped veneer surfaces using burn-in wood sticks, hard wax, and graining pens.
Maintain and calibrate wood shop machinery, keep saw blades sharp, and clear sawdust extraction hoods.
professions.summary: Craftsmanship-focused Furniture Carpenter skilled in assembling, building, and installing custom cabinetry, wardrobes, and modular joinery. Proficient in working with MDF, solid hardwoods, laminates, and edge-banding tapes using hand routers, saws, and biscuit joiners. Experienced in mounting soft-close drawer slides, cutting out countertop service sinks, and anchoring units securely to masonry walls. Dedicated to delivering seamless finish alignments, clean reveal margins, and durable furniture assemblies.

professions.name: Steel Fixer
duties: Read structural drawings and bar bending schedules to identify rebar sizes, shapes, spacings, and lap lengths.
Cut reinforced steel bars to required dimensions using manual lever shears or electric rebar cutting machines.
Bend deformed steel bars to designated angles and radius dimensions using manual bending tables or powered bar benders.
Position, space, and lay main reinforcing bars and distribution steel in foundations, footings, and retaining walls.
Tie intersecting rebar joints tightly using black annealed tie wire and manual pincer tools (tying hooks or pliers).
Assemble rebar cages for columns and heavy beams, placing stirrups, shear links, and spiral hoops at specified intervals.
Position concrete or plastic cover blocks (spacers) under rebar mats to guarantee specified concrete clear cover.
Secure rebar starter bars (dowels) into foundations and columns, tying them rigidly to prevent displacement during pours.
Install slab top mesh, cantilever reinforcement chairs, and edge u-bars according to approved structural drawings.
Check rebar cages for rigidity before concrete pours, adding diagonal tie braces to withstand pump hose vibrations.
professions.summary: Hardworking and safety-conscious Steel Fixer experienced in reinforcing concrete foundations, columns, beams, and slabs on major sites. Skilled in interpreting bar bending schedules (BBS), cutting steel bars, and bending high-tensile rebar to specified angles. Expert in tying rebar intersections securely using tying wire and pliers, and placing concrete cover spacer blocks correctly. Dedicated to ensuring rebar cages are structurally stable, plumb, and ready to withstand high-volume concrete pouring.

professions.name: Tile Mason
duties: Prepare concrete floor and wall substrates by cleaning, chipping loose material, and applying bonding agents.
Mix cement sand screeds and cast floor beds with precise slopes directing wastewater toward floor traps.
Mix tile adhesives and mortars using mechanical paddle mixers to reach the correct lump-free consistency.
Lay out tiles dry to balance cut sizes, center patterns, and align joint layouts with architectural features.
Apply tile mortar using notched trowels to ensure uniform combed ridges and full adhesive coverage under tiles.
Set ceramic, porcelain, and natural stone tiles, tapping them into place with rubber mallets to eliminate air voids.
Insert tile leveling clips, wedges, and cross spacers to eliminate lippage and maintain consistent joint widths.
Cut, notch, and core drill tiles for pipes, drains, and electrical backboxes using wet diamond saws and hole cutters.
Grind and polish exposed tile edges to a clean 45-degree mitre angle (jolly) for neat external corners.
Apply cementitious or epoxy tile grouts into joints using rubber floats, washing surfaces clean with sponge floats.
professions.summary: Skilled and detail-driven Tile Mason experienced in laying ceramic, porcelain, and natural stone tiles across floors and walls. Proficient in surface substrate preparation, screeding wet slopes toward floor drains, and mixing polymer-modified adhesives. Expert in utilizing mechanical leveling clip systems to eliminate lippage, cutting mitered edges, and applying clean grout lines.
