Dedicated to aesthetic pattern alignment, uniform joint widths, and executing hollow-free, durable tile installations.

professions.name: Block Mason
duties: Mix cement-sand mortar to required ratios and workability using mechanical mixers or manual pans.
Set corner guide blocks and stretch nylon string lines to establish straight, level wall courses.
Lay solid, hollow, and thermal aerated concrete blocks, bedding them in uniform mortar joints.
Check every block course for horizontal level, squareness, and vertical plumb using spirit levels.
Embed galvanized steel wall ties and wire mesh reinforcement into mortar beds at designated vertical intervals.
Position, level, and grout precast concrete or steel lintels over door, window, and service openings.
Rake out mortar joints while fresh to provide a key for future wall plastering or rendering coats.
Cut blocks to fractional sizes using masonry diamond saws, stone chisels, or bolster hammers.
Anchor masonry walls to reinforced concrete columns and shear walls using mechanical block ties.
Fill hollow block cores with micro-concrete grout around vertical tie bars in load-bearing masonry partitions.
professions.summary: Reliable and precise Block Mason experienced in constructing solid, hollow, and autoclaved aerated concrete (AAC) partition walls. Skilled in establishing level string-lines, mixing mortar to correct specifications, and laying uniform masonry courses. Proficient in integrating galvanized wall ties, rebar dowels, and installing structural precast lintels over wall openings. Focused on maintaining structural plumbness, raking joints cleanly for plastering, and minimizing material wastage on-site.

professions.name: Plaster Mason
duties: Hack, bush-hammer, or apply spatter-dash (rush coat) onto concrete surfaces to establish an adhesive mechanical key.
Fix galvanized iron (GI) plaster stop beads, corner beads, and control joints plumb along wall edges.
Cast vertical plaster screed strips at regular intervals to establish flat guide lines across large wall expanses.
Mix cement, sand, water, and plasticizing bonding agents to uniform plastering mortar consistencies.
Apply base (scratch) coats and finish plaster coats on internal blockwork and external boundary walls.
Rule off excess mortar using aluminum straightedges, floating surfaces to remove hollows, bumps, and ridges.
Finish plaster surfaces with wooden floats for a textured key or steel trowels for a smooth, even plane.
Apply fiberglass mesh reinforcement over joint junctions between masonry and concrete columns to stop cracks.
Wet-cure completed plastered surfaces with water twice daily for specified curing periods to prevent shrinkage checks.
Repair hollow, drummy, or blistered plaster by saw-cutting defective patches, chipping back, and re-rendering.
professions.summary: Experienced Plaster Mason proficient in applying internal and external cement-sand plaster, stucco, and decorative wall coatings. Skilled in preparing masonry substrates with rush coats, establishing true screed lines, and fixing corner and stop beads. Expert in ruling, floating, and troweling surfaces to achieve flat, plumb, and crack-free wall planes. Dedicated to proper wet-curing schedules and delivering sound, hollow-free surfaces ready for architectural finishing.

professions.name: Building Painter
duties: Clean, scrape, and scrape off old peeling paint, efflorescence, dust, and grease from wall and ceiling substrates.
Fill wall cracks, surface indentations, and imperfections using acrylic putty, gypsum filler, or exterior wall coats.
Sand walls smooth between putty coats using abrasive sanding blocks or orbital vacuum sanders.
Mask off adjacent surfaces, window trims, electrical switches, and finished floors with plastic sheeting and tape.
Apply alkali-resistant water-based primers onto bare plaster and drywall substrates to seal porosity.
Apply coats of emulsion, acrylic, and weather-resistant paints using professional rollers, brushes, and edgers.
Maintain wet edges while painting expansive wall sections to avoid roller lap marks and patchy sheens.
Spot-prime and apply finishing touch-ups after secondary trade work (plumbing/electrical) is completed.
Clean and maintain painting tools, wash roller sleeves, comb paintbrushes, and seal open paint buckets securely.
Comply with indoor air quality requirements by utilizing designated low-VOC paint systems in enclosed areas.
professions.summary: Detail-oriented Building Painter experienced in surface preparation and applying protective and decorative architectural coatings. Proficient in scraping substrates, applying acrylic putty, sanding surfaces smooth, and masking delicate adjacent fixtures. Skilled in applying primers, emulsions, and weatherproof paints using rollers, brushes, and edge tools without lap marks. Dedicated to maintaining clean work areas, executing color touch-ups, and adhering strictly to low-VOC indoor standards.

professions.name: Spray Painter
duties: Mix paints, polyurethanes, primers, and thinners to specified viscosities using Zahn cups and flow meters.
Set up, prime, and operate high-pressure airless spray rigs and high-volume low-pressure (HVLP) spray guns.
Adjust spray gun air pressures, fluid delivery needles, and fan patterns to achieve uniform coating thicknesses.
Mask expansive glass windows, structural columns, and floors meticulously using masking paper and film tape.
Apply heavy epoxy coatings and anti-corrosive primer systems to structural steelwork and industrial metal frames.
Spray architectural coatings, textured paints, and lacquers on doors, millwork panels, and cladding sheets.
Check wet film thickness (WFT) using comb gauges to ensure compliance with paint manufacturer specifications.
Flush, strip, and clean spray gun bodies, fluid tips, pick-up tubes, and manifold filters with solvents daily.
Troubleshoot spraying defects such as paint runs, orange peel, overspray, dry spray, and pinholing immediately.
Wear assigned chemical respirators, spray hoods, and eye protection when spraying in confined or vented booths.
professions.summary: Technical and skilled Spray Painter experienced in operating high-pressure airless and HVLP spray application equipment. Expert in mixing primers, urethanes, thinners, and epoxy coats to specified viscosities using Zahn measurement cups. Proficient in masking large surfaces, adjusting spray fan patterns, and maintaining uniform wet film thickness (WFT). Focused on booth safety, meticulous spray gun cleaning, and preventing coating runs, orange peel, and overspray.

professions.name: Gypsum Board Installer
duties: Lay out partition wall tracks on floors and soffits using laser levels, chalk snap lines, and plumb lines.
Fasten floor and ceiling galvanized metal runners (U-tracks) using powder-actuated fasteners or nylon anchors.
Cut and insert vertical galvanized light steel studs (C-studs) at designated center-to-center spacings.
Install timber or heavy-gauge steel backing plates inside drywall cavities to support future wall-hung items.
Measure, score, snap, and rasp edges of regular, moisture-resistant (green), or fire-rated (pink) gypsum boards.
Fasten gypsum plasterboards to metal framing using bugle-head drywall screws set flush with auto-stop drivers.
Cut accurate openings into drywall boards for electrical switch boxes, access panels, and plumbing stubs.
Install mineral wool or acoustic rockwool insulation batts inside stud cavities before boarding the second face.
Fit metal corner beads, shadow line trims, and control joints along external drywall edges and wall intersections.
Inspect drywall runs for true alignment, plumbness, and screw popping prior to passing the board to tapers.
professions.summary: Productive Gypsum Board Installer specialized in framing and cladding drywall partition walls and acoustic bulkheads. Proficient in shooting laser guidelines, fastening galvanized floor and ceiling tracks, and spacing vertical metal studs. Skilled in scoring, snapping, and screwing standard, moisture-resistant, and fire-rated gypsum boards without surface popping. Experienced in framing service openings for MEP access panels, inserting soundproofing wool, and installing metal corner trims.

professions.name: False Ceiling Technician
duties: Shoot datum levels along room perimeters using multi-directional cross-line laser leveling instruments.
Fix galvanized perimeter wall angles (L-angles or shadow trims) to walls at the approved ceiling elevation.
Drill slab soffits and anchor adjustable suspension hanger wire rods, butterfly clips, and anchor pins.
Suspend, space, and level main runners for concealed gypsum ceilings or exposed 60x60 acoustic lay-in grids.
Snap cross-tees firmly into main runners at right angles to create square ceiling modules (600x600 mm).
Lay acoustic mineral fiber, perforated metal, or PVC-laminated ceiling tiles into the suspended grid framework.
Cut perimeter border tiles cleanly to match wall offsets and irregular room dimensions.
Coordinate framing openings with MEP trades for supply diffusers, return air grilles, downlights, and sprinklers.
Adjust suspension hanger clips across ceiling runs to eliminate surface sagging and align grid joints flush.
Replace damaged, sagging, or water-stained ceiling panels during preventative maintenance calls and renovations.
professions.summary: Precision-focused False Ceiling Technician experienced in installing suspended ceiling grids, acoustic boards, and concealed gypsum ceilings. Proficient in shooting perimeter datum elevations using cross-line lasers and anchoring adjustable ceiling hanger rods. Skilled in assembling heavy-duty main runners, interlocking cross-tees, and laying 60x60 acoustic tiles cleanly. Adept at cutting border panels, adjusting drop heights to eliminate sagging, and framing openings for lighting and diffusers.

professions.name: MIG Welder
duties: Set up and configure GMAW/MIG welding machines, setting correct voltage, polarity, and wire feed speeds.
Select, mount, and feed appropriate solid mild steel, aluminum, or flux-cored wire spools through gun liners.
Adjust shielding gas flow rates (Argon, CO2, or mixed gas) on pressure regulators to avoid weld porosity.
Clean and prepare joint bevels, removing mill scale, rust, and oil using heavy-duty angle grinders and wire wheels.
Clamp, align, and tack-weld carbon steel plates, structural beams, and pipe spools into true joint fits.
Execute fillet, butt, and lap welds in flat, horizontal, vertical, and overhead positions to welding procedure specs (WPS).
Remove spatter from workpieces using scrapers, wire brushes, and pneumatic needle scalers.
Inspect finished weld beads visually for defects including undercut, lack of penetration, porosity, and burn-through.
Replace worn welding gun contact tips, gas nozzles, wire drive rolls, and clean anti-spatter paste daily.
Operate overhead shop hoists and clamps to manipulate heavy weldments safely while wearing welding helmets.
professions.summary: Certified GMAW/MIG Welder with extensive experience in structural steel fabrication, metal assemblies, and equipment repair. Skilled in setting machine parameters, feeding wire alloys, and regulating shielding gas mixtures to prevent weld porosity. Proficient in executing high-strength fillet, butt, and lap joints across all welding positions according to approved WPS specifications. Dedicated to joint preparation, grinding weld spatter cleanly, and inspecting beads to eliminate undercut and lack of fusion.

professions.name: TIG Welder
duties: Assemble and maintain TIG torches, collets, gas lenses, and pink alumina ceramic cups.
Dress and grind non-consumable tungsten electrodes (pure, thoriated, ceriated) to fine points using dedicated wheels.
Regulate pure argon shielding gas flows and assemble back-purging dams inside pipes to shield root passes.
Strike and maintain smooth, stable electric arcs using foot pedals or torch triggers with high-frequency units.
Feed thin filler metal wire into the weld puddle manually with coordinated, steady two-handed dexterity.
Weld thin-gauge stainless steel, aluminum, brass, and carbon steel pipe joints without blowouts or heat warping.
Execute full-penetration open-root welds on high-pressure piping certified to ASME/AWS X-ray standards.
Regulate amperage pulses precisely to minimize heat input, preventing carbide precipitation and distortion.
Passivate and clean finished stainless steel weld seams using pickling paste or electrochemical brush cleaners.
Inspect welded pipe roots internally using optical borescopes and mirrors to verify complete fusion.
professions.summary: High-precision GTAW/TIG Welder specialized in joining stainless steel, aluminum, carbon steel, and specialized alloy piping networks. Expert in dressing tungsten electrodes, setting pulse amperages, and creating sealed argon back-purging dams inside pipe bores. Skilled in manual two-handed filler rod feeding to produce smooth, full-penetration open-root welds meeting X-ray standards. Focused on heat control to prevent warping, cleaning finished welds with pickling paste, and ensuring sterile joint fusion.

professions.name: Structural Fabricator
duties: Interpret structural steel fabrication blueprints, connection details, and bill of materials (BOM).
Measure and lay out cut lines, hole center points, and cope cuts on steel beams, columns, and plates.
Cut heavy structural shapes (I-beams, H-sections, channels) using manual oxy-acetylene torches or band saws.
Bevel structural steel flanges and web plates to prepare joint profiles for full-penetration welding.
Drill, punch, or ream bolt holes in base plates, gusset plates, and end cleats using magnetic base drills.
Fit, clamp, and assemble fabricated components onto structural members using hydraulic clamps and dog pins.
Tack-weld structural assemblies securely in place to maintain correct angles, squareness, and tolerances.
Rig and guide heavy steel members through shop bays using overhead bridge cranes, plate clamps, and wire slings.
Grind structural cut faces, bevel edges, and fit-ups to remove sharp dross, slag, and rough burrs.
Stamp or paint heat numbers and unique part assembly marks onto completed pieces to ensure site traceability.
professions.summary: Heavy Industrial Structural Fabricator skilled in reading complex steel construction drawings, weld maps, and bills of materials. Expert in marking cut lines, operating oxy-acetylene torches, and utilizing magnetic base drills to punch connection holes. Proficient in fitting, clamping, and tack-welding heavy I-beams, columns, and gusset plates within strict shop tolerances. Dedicated to workshop safety, crane rigging for heavy steel elements, and applying part traceability numbers.

professions.name: Aluminum Fabricator
duties: Interpret architectural drawings and cutting lists for aluminum windows, curtain walls, doors, and louvers.
Cut extruded aluminum profile sections to exact dimensions and angles using double-head compound miter saws.
Machine slots, drainage weeps, mortise pockets, and lock cylinder holes using copy routing machines.
Drill mounting holes and insert mechanical corner cleats, corner brackets, and joint connection screws.
Crimp and stake aluminum corner joints using pneumatic or hydraulic corner-combining machines.
Press and roll EPDM rubber weatherstrip gaskets into dedicated profile grooves along sash and frame tracks.
Assemble thermal break and non-thermal break architectural frames, ensuring tight hairline corner miters.
Mount multi-point locks, friction hinges, sliding rollers, flush bolts, and push handles onto finished frames.
Apply structural silicone and sealants along frame joints to prevent air leakage and water infiltration.
Wrap completed aluminum frame assemblies with protective plastic film and tape to prevent transit scratches.
professions.summary: Skilled Aluminum Fabricator experienced in manufacturing architectural windows, sliding doors, curtain walls, and exterior louvers. Proficient in cutting extruded aluminum profiles using double-head compound miter saws and machining lock slots via copy routers. Expert in installing corner crimp cleats, inserting EPDM rubber gaskets, and mounting multi-point hardware mechanisms. Committed to delivering seamless miter joints, applying weatherproof structural silicone, and protecting finished powder-coated frames.

professions.name: Glazier
duties: Unload, maneuver, and lift heavy glass sheets, insulated glass units (IGUs), and mirrors using vacuum suction lifters.
Cut, score, and snap single-pane float glass and laminated panels manually using diamond-tipped glass cutters.
Install tempered, laminated, and double-glazed units into aluminum curtain walls, window sashes, and shopfronts.
Position neoprene setting blocks and edge spacers correctly beneath glass panels to prevent metal-to-glass contact.
Secure glass units inside metal frames using aluminum pressure plates, snap-on cover caps, and glazing beads.
Apply weather-sealing structural silicone along external perimeter joints using pneumatic sealant dispensing guns.
Smooth and tool silicone sealant beads to achieve clean, waterproof, and aesthetically uniform transitions.
Install frameless interior glass partitions, spider fittings, sliding glass doors, and shower enclosures.
Remove broken or shattered glass safely during maintenance callouts without causing injuries or frame damage.
Wear assigned cut-resistant gloves, wrist gauntlets, and safety glasses during all handling and cutting operations.
professions.summary: Safety-focused and methodical Glazier experienced in cutting, handling, and installing architectural glass for facades and interiors. Proficient in lifting insulated glass units (IGUs) and heavy mirrors using multi-pad suction lifters and shop cranes. Skilled in setting neoprene spacing blocks, snapping aluminum cover caps, and tooling smooth structural silicone weather seals. Dedicated to installing frameless glass partitions, shower doors, and replacing fractured glass panels without frame damage.

professions.name: Scaffolder
duties: Inspect ground conditions and lay heavy timber sole plates and adjustable screw jacks to form firm scaffold bases.
Erect system scaffolding (Cuplock, Ringlock) and conventional tube-and-fitting scaffolding following load designs.
Connect vertical standards, horizontal ledgers, and transoms, locking cups or tightening couplers with scaffold spanners.
Install diagonal facade braces and plan braces to provide rigid lateral stability against wind and live loads.
Lay timber scaffold boards and steel walk-planks tightly across bays to create fully decked working platforms.
Fix double-guardrails (top and mid-rails) and toe-boards along all open sides to prevent falls of workers and tools.
Anchor scaffolds to adjacent concrete walls and structural columns using mechanical tie anchors and box ties.
Assist certified scaffolding inspectors during weekly structural audits and update green/red scaffold inspection tags.
Dismantle scaffold structures methodically in reverse order of erection, passing components down safely.
Maintain 100% tie-off using twin-tail energy-absorbing fall arrest lanyards whenever working at unprotected edges.
professions.summary: Safety-conscious and certified Scaffolder experienced in erecting, modifying, and dismantling Cuplock, Ringlock, and tube-and-fitting systems. Skilled in inspecting ground conditions, leveling sole plates, placing screw jacks, and locking horizontal ledgers securely. Proficient in laying timber deck platforms, fixing toe-boards, double guardrails, and tying scaffolds to structural columns. Committed to 100% harness tie-off compliance at heights and supporting third-party tagging inspections.

professions.name: Rigging Slinger
duties: Inspect wire rope slings, synthetic webbing belts, chain slings, and bow shackles for defects prior to every lift.
Calculate load weights and determine the true center of gravity to select correct rigging capacity and angles.
Attach lifting slings to load pick points using appropriate chokers, basket hitches, or direct vertical hitches.
Direct mobile, crawler, and tower crane operators using standard audible whistle codes and hand signals.
Guide suspended loads through complex airspace and tight plant areas using attached non-conductive tag lines.
Clear crane swing paths and keep all site personnel out from under suspended loads and travel corridors.
Assist in positioning, landing, and stabilizing heavy structural beams, transformers, and chillers onto foundations.
Disconnect and remove rigging gear once the load is verified as completely stable and secured in position.
Segregate, tag out, and dispose of damaged slings, bent shackles, or overstretched lifting hardware.
Comply with third-party lifting operation plans, lift permits, and prevailing maximum wind speed limits.
professions.summary: Certified Rigging Slinger skilled in lifting operations, slinging techniques, and crane communication across heavy construction sites. Expert in inspecting slings, chains, and shackles, calculating load center of gravity, and applying proper hitch configurations. Highly proficient in directing crane operators through standard hand signals, radio protocols, and controlling loads with tag lines. Dedicated to keeping personnel clear of suspended loads, managing pick clearances, and complying with lift plans.

professions.name: Auto Electrician
duties: Connect automotive diagnostic scanners to vehicle OBD2 ports to read, analyze, and clear fault trouble codes (DTCs).
Trace open circuits, parasitic battery drains, short circuits, and ground faults using digital multimeters and test lights.
Dismantle, test, bench-repair, and overhaul faulty starter motors and charging alternators.
Inspect, test, and replace 12V/24V lead-acid and AGM vehicle batteries, cleaning corroded terminals and cable clamps.
Repair and re-pin broken automotive wiring harnesses, wrapping finished bundles with high-temp harness loom tape.
Troubleshoot and replace faulty vehicle lighting components, headlamps, turn signals, relays, and fuse boxes.
Diagnose modern body control modules (BCM), power window regulators, central locking actuators, and keyless fobs.
Install aftermarket electronic accessories including reverse cameras, parking sensors, dash cams, and GPS trackers.
Test and replace malfunctioning engine management sensors like oxygen sensors, MAF sensors, and throttle bodies.
Ensure repaired vehicle circuits are protected by appropriately rated fuses and match OEM wiring schematics.
professions.summary: Diagnostic-focused Auto Electrician experienced in troubleshooting complex vehicle electrical architectures, wiring harnesses, and charging systems. Proficient in using OBD2 scanning tools to interpret diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs), reading schematics, and tracking voltage drops. Skilled in repairing alternators, starter motors, replacing damaged relay modules, and repinning automotive wiring looms. Focused on properly sizing circuit fuses, restoring sensor signals, and installing accessories like cameras and GPS units.

professions.name: Auto Mechanic
duties: Perform scheduled minor and major vehicle services including engine oil, oil filter, air filter, and plug changes.
Inspect, service, and rebuild disc and drum brake systems, machining rotors and replacing worn brake pads.
Dismantle, measure tolerances on, and overhaul internal combustion engines (pistons, cylinder heads, crankshafts).
Replace vehicle suspension and steering components including shock absorbers, control arms, ball joints, and tie rods.
Replace engine timing belts, timing chains, water pumps, tensioners, and serpentine accessory drive belts.
Perform automatic and manual transmission fluid flushes, clutch plate replacements, and differential oil changes.
Pressure test vehicle cooling radiators, replace thermostats, diagnose coolant leaks, and bleed air from systems.
Inspect vehicle exhaust systems for catalytic converter restrictions, broken hangers, and manifold leaks.
Lift vehicles safely on two-post and four-post hydraulic workshop lifts following vehicle pick-point guides.
Road-test repaired vehicles to evaluate handling, listen for unusual mechanical noises, and confirm repair quality.
professions.summary: Comprehensive Auto Mechanic skilled in diagnosing, servicing, and overhauling mechanical systems on passenger cars and light fleet trucks. Experienced in performing oil services, overhauling disc and drum brakes, and replacing suspension bushings, struts, and steering racks. Capable of executing engine timing belt replacements, water pump installations, manual clutch swaps, and transmission fluid flushes. Dedicated to lifting vehicles safely on workshop hoists, running road tests, and ensuring vehicle roadworthiness.

professions.name: Automotive AC Technician
duties: Connect automotive AC gauge sets to low and high ports to diagnose compressor operating pressures and subcooling.
Recover old refrigerant safely into recovery stations and pull deep vacuums to remove moisture from the system.
Detect car AC refrigerant leaks using electronic halogen sniffers, nitrogen pressure holds, and UV fluorescent dyes.
Replace worn AC compressors, magnetic clutch assemblies, drive pulleys, and electromagnetic coil windings.
Remove vehicle dashboards carefully to replace leaking or clogged interior AC evaporator cores and expansion valves.
Wash, straighten cooling fins on, or replace road-damaged front air-conditioning condensers and receiver-driers.
Charge vehicle AC systems with exact gram weights of R134a or R1234yf refrigerants and inject correct PAG oil.
Diagnose and replace malfunctioning interior blower fan motors, blower resistors, and cabin dust air filters.
Troubleshoot electronic climate control actuators, blend doors, and cabin temperature thermistors.
Verify vent output temperatures with digital probe thermometers to confirm system achieves specified cooling.
professions.summary: Specialized Automotive AC Technician experienced in servicing, troubleshooting, and repairing mobile air-conditioning and climate systems. Proficient in connecting manifold pressure gauges, pulling deep vacuums, and charging systems with exact weights of R134a or R1234yf. Skilled in pinpointing leaks using nitrogen and electronic sniffers, replacing faulty compressors, and swapping interior evaporator cores. Focused on clearing clogged cabin filters, servicing blend-door actuators, and achieving rapid cooling vent temperatures.

professions.name: Car Denter
duties: Inspect collision-damaged vehicle bodywork to determine repair viability versus complete panel replacement.
Disassemble damaged vehicle trim, headlights, doors, and interior linings to access structural sheet metal panels.
Straighten minor and major body panel dents using specialized metal-shaping body hammers, dollies, and spoons.
Pull deep sheet metal creases from closed cavities using spot-welded dent-puller studs and slide hammers.
Align vehicle unibody frames and structural pillars (A, B, C-pillars) using computerized chassis alignment benches.
Shrink stretched sheet metal panels using oxy-acetylene heat spots or carbon electrode shrinking tools.
Weld replacement body panels, quarter panels, and sill sections using spot-welding and MIG brazing machines.
Repair cracked, torn, or warped plastic bumper covers and side skirts using hot plastic staple welders.
Align door gaps, hood gaps, and trunk lid clearances to match factory vehicle panel tolerances.
Clean and prepare straightened bare metal surfaces, applying initial rust-inhibiting etch primers over repairs.
professions.summary: Skilled Panel Beater and Car Denter experienced in repairing accident-damaged vehicle sheet metal and restoring body contours. Proficient in using specialized body hammers, dollies, hydraulic rams, and spot-welder stud dent-pulling tools. Skilled in aligning vehicle unibody frames, adjusting panel gaps on doors and hoods, and repairing plastic bumper cracks. Committed to metal shrinking, rust-inhibiting primer application, and restoring structural sheet metal integrity.

professions.name: Auto Spray Painter
duties: Mix, apply, and block-sand polyester body filler over repaired metal panels to achieve level body contours.
Feather-edge surrounding paint finishes smoothly using dual-action (DA) orbital sanders and guide coats.
Mask off vehicle windows, trim, wheels, and adjacent body panels meticulously using automotive paper and film.
Apply high-build primer-surfacers, baking them in spray booths before dry guide sanding to fine grit finishes.
Match OEM paint colors using digital spectrophotometers and mix basecoat tints precisely on automated scales.
Spray basecoats evenly over prepared panels inside downdraft spray booths at regulated air and temperature levels.
Apply multi-layer protective clear coats, ensuring optimal wet-edge overlap to prevent orange peel and paint runs.
Bake freshly coated vehicles inside heated spray booths to accelerate paint curing and hardness.
Wet-sand cured clear coat finishes to remove embedded dust nibs using ultra-fine grits (P2000-P3000).
Compound, buff, and polish vehicle surfaces with rotary polishers to achieve high-gloss, swirl-free finishes.
professions.summary: Craftsmanship-driven Auto Spray Painter skilled in refinishing automotive bodies inside modern downdraft spray booths. Expert in applying and block-sanding polyester fillers, spray-applying high-build primers, and feather-edging repaired body panels. Proficient in digital spectrophotometer color matching, mixing basecoats, and spraying uniform multi-coat clear finishes. Dedicated to baking paint layers to maximum hardness, wet-sanding dust nibs, and buffing panels to high gloss.

professions.name: Wheel Alignment Technician
duties: Drive vehicles onto 4-post alignment racks, mount wheel targets, and clamp rolling sensor heads accurately.
Roll vehicles to sweep steering angles and compensate for runout on computerized 3D alignment systems.
Interpret live screen alignment readings for camber, caster, toe-in/toe-out, and thrust angles.
Adjust front and rear tie rods, eccentric cam bolts, and suspension shims to match manufacturer OEM specs.
Center vehicle steering wheels perfectly using mechanical steering wheel holder locks during toe adjustment.
Disassemble, mount, and seat new tires onto alloy and steel wheel rims using automated tire changers.
Balance wheel and tire assemblies dynamically on spin balancers, applying adhesive or clip-on lead-free weights.
Inspect tire tread patterns for abnormal wear indicators (feathering, cupping, camber wear) to diagnose issues.
Repair punctured tires safely from the inside using vulcanizing chemical plug-patch combination units.
Reset and reprogram tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS) wheel sensors using specialized handheld tools.
professions.summary: Technical Wheel Alignment and Tire Technician skilled in operating computerized 3D alignment racks and dynamic wheel balancers. Expert in reading camber, caster, and toe angles, adjusting tie rods and eccentric bolts to match factory manufacturer specifications. Proficient in mounting, dismounting, and seating low-profile tires using tire changers without scratching expensive alloy wheel rims. Dedicated to assessing irregular tire wear, performing internal radial patch repairs, and recalibrating TPMS sensors.

professions.name: Heavy Equipment Mechanic
duties: Perform preventative maintenance and scheduled servicing on excavators, bulldozers, wheel loaders, and graders.
Troubleshoot and rebuild heavy-duty multi-cylinder turbocharged diesel engines and common-rail fuel systems.
Connect pressure test kits to main hydraulic pump manifolds to measure relief pressures and pilot controls.
Remove, reseal, and rebuild leaking hydraulic cylinders, directional control valves, and hydraulic swivel joints.
Inspect heavy equipment undercarriages, measuring wear on track chains, bottom rollers, idlers, and sprockets.
Adjust crawler track tension on heavy machinery using grease guns and hydraulic tensioning cylinders.
Diagnose and repair hydrostatic drive systems, heavy planetary final drives, and differential assemblies.
Replace worn bucket teeth, cutting edges, side cutters, and pins on earthmoving and loading attachments.
Disassemble and repair pneumatic brake systems, air compressors, and air-dryer cartridges on construction trucks.
Torque critical high-tensile track bolts, counterweights, and slew ring bolts using hydraulic torque multipliers.
professions.summary: Field-tested Heavy Equipment Mechanic experienced in troubleshooting heavy diesel machinery, crawler excavators, and wheel loaders. Proficient in reading hydraulic schematics, connecting pressure gauges to main pump manifolds, and rebuilding leaking cylinders. Skilled in overhauling multi-cylinder turbocharged diesel engines, servicing hydrostatic transmissions, and adjusting steel crawler track tension. Focused on replacing earthmoving ground-engaging tools, torquing slew ring bolts, and reducing machinery downtime.

professions.name: Forklift Operator
duties: Perform daily pre-operational checks on forklift fluid levels, tire condition, hydraulic mast hoses, and safety alarms.
Maneuver counterbalance and reach trucks safely through narrow warehouse aisles, loading bays, and staging zones.
Align forks, assess pallet load capacity charts, and verify weight distribution before lifting heavy goods.
Elevate and seat pallets securely onto high-bay storage racking systems without damaging crossbeams or items.
Unload and load flatbed delivery trucks, sea shipping containers, and tautliners safely at loading docks.
Transport loaded pallets across logistics floors with loads tilted back and forks kept 10–15 cm off the ground.
Sound horns at blind intersections, obey warehouse speed limits, and yield immediately to foot pedestrians.
Swap depleted industrial batteries on electric forklifts using hoists, or replace LPG gas fuel cylinders safely.
Report rack strikes, defective safety interlocks, hydraulic oil leaks, and damaged wooden pallets to supervisors.
Park forklifts in designated charging bays with the mast tilted forward, forks flat on the floor, and brake set.
professions.summary: Certified and vigilant Forklift Operator experienced in operating counterbalance and reach trucks across high-density logistics facilities. Skilled in maneuvering through narrow storage aisles, staging freight, and stacking loaded pallets into high-bay racking systems. Proficient in executing pre-shift safety checks, verifying pallet weight capacities, and operating safely around pedestrian pathways. Committed to warehouse speed limits, safe battery swapping, and maintaining zero inventory or rack collision damage.

professions.name: Mobile Crane Operator
duties: Inspect crane wire ropes, boom sections, hooks, hydraulic lines, and fluid levels before commencing daily lifts.
Evaluate ground bearing conditions, lay timber outrigger pads, and extend hydraulic stabilizers to full level width.
Configure the computerized Load Moment Indicator (LMI) with correct boom lengths, counterweights, and parts of line.
Lift, swing, and land heavy precast panels, structural steel elements, and machinery within certified net chart limits.
Work in direct coordination with certified banksmen and rigging slingers via approved two-way radios and hand signals.
Avoid abrupt slewing, swinging, or sudden braking to keep suspended loads balanced directly under the boom tip.
Monitor wind speeds using digital anemometers, shutting down operations when winds exceed safety thresholds.
Check clearance distances constantly from overhead high-voltage power lines and surrounding stationary structures.
Execute complex dual-crane tandem lifts and blind picks strictly following engineered lifting plan procedures.
Retract the telescopic boom, pin outriggers, and secure the hook block in the travel bracket at shift completion.
professions.summary: Licensed and safety-focused Mobile Crane Operator experienced in operating all-terrain, rough-terrain, and truck-mounted telescopic cranes. Skilled in setting outriggers on timber mats, checking ground stability, and configuring digital Load Moment Indicators (LMI). Proficient in executing smooth, non-swinging load lifts in close coordination with certified banksmen and rigging teams. Dedicated to monitoring wind speeds, maintaining overhead powerline clearances, and adhering strictly to lift plans.

professions.name: Tower Crane Operator
duties: Climb mast access ladders wearing full vertical fall-arrest gear to reach the operator cab safely at high elevations.
Inspect hoist cables, trolley ropes, limit switches, and electric motor brakes on top decks before operations begin.
Operate joystick controls smoothly to hoist, lower, swing the jib, and trolley loads across construction floors.
Execute high-elevation blind lifts into building cores guided entirely by radio instructions from certified slingers.
Calculate dynamic swing radius and load ratings carefully to prevent tipping moments or structural mast overstress.
Monitor live cab wind velocity gauges, suspending lifting instantly if sustained wind speeds reach 38 km/h or higher.
Transport concrete delivery buckets, rebar bundles, shuttering panels, and site supplies directly to working floors.
Maintain clear visual tracking of site pedestrian paths, avoiding slewing suspended loads directly over active work crews.
Log daily operating hours, structural observations, unusual mechanical vibrations, and cable spooling issues.
Release the mechanical slew brake at shift end to leave the tower crane completely free to weather-vane in wind.
professions.summary: Skilled and focused Tower Crane Operator experienced in operating top-slewing cranes on high-rise residential and commercial towers. Expert in hoisting, trolleying, and slewing loads smoothly to high building decks while maintaining precise hook line control. Proficient in executing blind lifts guided purely by banksman two-way radio instructions to deliver concrete and formwork. Dedicated to pre-operational cable inspections, cab anemometer monitoring, and safe end-of-shift free-slewing protocols.

professions.name: Excavator Operator
duties: Carry out walk-around inspections of excavator track tension, bucket pins, hydraulic hoses, and engine oil levels.
Dig foundation footings, drainage trenches, and basement pits to exact surveyor grade markers and depths.
Angle trench walls and bench excavations safely according to geotechnical soil classifications to avoid cave-ins.
Change front attachments (trenching buckets, rock breakers, hydraulic shears) using quick-hitch couplers.
Break through bedrock, hard limestone, and reinforced concrete surfaces using heavy hydraulic hammer attachments.
Grade, shape, and level sub-base road surfaces and soil embankments cleanly using wide tilt-ditching buckets.
Locate and expose underground utilities cautiously by hand or using spotters to prevent striking water or power pipes.
Load articulated dump trucks and tippers steadily, balancing soil distribution to avoid spilling loads over sides.
Travel up and down rough terrain slopes safely, keeping heavy attachments low to ground level for stability.
Clean packed mud and clay out of undercarriage track assemblies daily using the bucket tip before shutdown.
professions.summary: Precision-driven Excavator Operator experienced in operating tracked and wheeled excavators on infrastructure and civil worksites. Skilled in trenching to surveyor grade stakes, sloping and benching deep pit walls, and loading dump trucks smoothly. Proficient in operating auxiliary attachments including hydraulic rock hammers, screening buckets, and quick-hitch couplers. Focused on verifying underground utility clearances, maintaining track cleanout, and traversing steep slopes safely.

professions.name: Heavy Bus Driver
duties: Drive 50–60 passenger commercial buses safely across UAE urban routes, highways, and industrial worker accommodations.
Complete pre-trip inspections checking tire pressures, air brake systems, passenger seatbelts, and exit doors.
Maintain steady speeds and safe following distances, adhering strictly to UAE highway limits and RTA speed radars.
Pull buses flush against passenger curbs to ensure workers or passengers board and alight smoothly and safely.
Operate passenger climate control air conditioning systems to maintain comfortable cabin temperatures year-round.
Verify bus route schedules and pick-up timing points accurately to prevent labor transfer and transit delays.
Manage passenger behavior calmly, ensuring travelers remain seated while the vehicle is in motion on roadways.
Follow emergency protocols during tire blowouts or vehicle fires, guiding passengers out through escape hatches.
Clean interior passenger decks, inspect for forgotten personal luggage, and check seats for tears after routes.
Maintain trip run sheets, fuel log vouchers, and report mechanical steering or transmission faults to fleet depots.
professions.summary: Professional, RTA-licensed Heavy Bus Driver experienced in transporting commercial passengers and large worker workforces safely across the UAE. Skilled in defensive driving, managing blind spots, adhering strictly to road speed limits, and operating pneumatic air brakes. Proficient in conducting daily fluid and tire pre-trip checks, keeping transit schedules, and managing bus climate controls. Committed to passenger safety, calm passenger management, and executing immediate emergency evacuation protocols if needed.

professions.name: Heavy Truck Driver
duties: Inspect prime movers, flatbeds, and multi-axle trailers (brake lines, fifth-wheel kingpins, lights, and tires).
Transport heavy bulk materials, shipping containers, and aggregate safely between ports, quarries, and job sites.
Check and secure cargo loads using high-tensile ratchet straps, chains, binders, and heavy weatherproof tarpaulins.
Maneuver large articulated combination vehicles smoothly through congested urban roads and tight industrial lanes.
Reverse articulated tractor-trailers into narrow logistics loading docks accurately using side mirrors and spotters.
Pass through official road weigh stations to verify axle weights remain within legal UAE transport load limits.
Monitor pneumatic air pressure gauges constantly, bleeding air water traps and avoiding heavy brake fade on descents.
Adhere strictly to heavy vehicle road-lane bans, bridge height restrictions, and restricted daytime transit hours.
Deliver shipping bills of lading, customs clearance manifests, and delivery receipts to receiving site officers.
Fuel trucks at depot pumps, record DEF fluid consumption, and log tire wear patterns for preventive shop maintenance.
professions.summary: Dependable and safety-conscious Heavy Truck Driver experienced in operating multi-axle prime movers, tippers, and articulated flatbed trailers. Skilled in securing heavy cargo using high-tensile ratchet straps, chains, and tarpaulins to prevent load shifts. Proficient in reversing into tight industrial loading bays, navigating long-haul highways, and monitoring air brake pressures. Committed to weighbridge legal axle limits, road lane bans, and maintaining clean vehicle trip sheets and logbooks.

professions.name: Light Duty Driver
duties: Operate company passenger cars, pickup trucks, and 1-tonne commercial panel vans safely across city routes.
Perform morning vehicle checks on engine oil, radiator coolant, windshield washer fluid, and tire pressures.
Deliver office documents, technical spare parts, tools, and company staff promptly to designated city locations.
Navigate dynamic road traffic and construction detours using smartphone GPS apps like Google Maps and Waze.
Park vehicles safely in authorized street bays and basement parking slots, avoiding traffic fines and tow zones.
Secure small packages, delicate toolboxes, and boxed cargo inside rear beds using cargo nets and bungee straps.
Obtain signatures, stamps, and physical delivery confirmations on invoices and delivery advice notes.
Wash exterior vehicle bodywork and vacuum passenger seats regularly to keep vehicles clean and professional.
Track and report periodic vehicle oil change schedules, RTA annual registration renewals, and Salik toll top-ups.
Report any road traffic collisions immediately, taking photos and obtaining Dubai Police green/red accident reports.
professions.summary: Punctual and courteous Light Duty Driver experienced in operating passenger cars, courier vans, and 1-tonne pickup trucks across urban centers. Skilled in route optimization using GPS apps, navigating city detours, and practicing defensive driving to avoid traffic fines. Proficient in verifying cargo paperwork, securing parcels, and obtaining authorized delivery signatures from customers. Dedicated to maintaining vehicle cleanliness, checking tire pressures and fluid levels, and monitoring vehicle registration renewals.

professions.name: Warehouse Supervisor
duties: Supervise daily receiving, storing, picking, and dispatching operations within the main logistics warehouse facility.
Assign daily picking and packing quotas to warehouse helpers, material handlers, and forklift drivers.
Manage space allocation across high-bay pallet racking, bulk zones, and staging bays to optimize warehouse flow.
Monitor Warehouse Management System (WMS) data to ensure inventory bin locations match physical stock counts.
Lead scheduled cycle counts and annual wall-to-wall physical stock audits, investigating variance causes.
Enforce strict warehouse health and safety rules, ensuring clear fire exits, proper footwear, and forklift lanes.
Review pick lists, pack lists, and shipping invoices to ensure zero-error dispatches to retail stores or sites.
Coordinate with freight forwarders, container drivers, and customs transport clearing agents for dock timings.
Train newly hired warehouse personnel on standard operating procedures, RF gun usage, and safe lifting ergonomics.
Generate weekly warehouse KPIs, tracking space utilization, picking speed, and damaged goods metrics for leadership.
professions.summary: Organized Warehouse Supervisor skilled in coordinating receiving, picking, packing, and dispatch operations in fast-paced distribution hubs. Proficient in managing Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), optimizing pallet storage racking space, and tracking inventory turnover. Experienced in scheduling labor shifts, conducting regular cycle counts, and investigating physical stock variance root causes. Dedicated to enforcing strict floor safety guidelines, supervising forklift traffic, and achieving on-time delivery metrics.

professions.name: Logistics Coordinator
duties: Coordinate end-to-end import and export freight shipments across sea containers, air cargo, and cross-border road trucks.
Prepare, check, and process shipping documentation including commercial invoices, packing lists, and Certificates of Origin.
Track moving shipments via ocean carrier and air tracking portals, updating internal project teams on delivery ETAs.
Communicate daily with third-party logistics (3PL) service providers, shipping lines, and local customs clearing brokers.
Cross-check customs duty tariffs, HS code classifications, and import inspection approvals via Dubai Trade or Mirsal.
Consolidate shipment orders from international suppliers to optimize container loading and lower freight transport expenses.
Enter purchase orders, shipping milestones, and inventory receipts accurately into company ERP enterprise software.
Resolve transportation delays, dock demurrage warnings, container detention fees, and damaged freight claims.
Schedule transport dispatches from local port terminals directly to company warehouses and customer job sites.
Review shipping freight forwarder bills, tally extra charges against quotes, and submit approved invoices to accounts.
professions.summary: Proactive Logistics Coordinator experienced in tracking end-to-end import, export, and cross-border road freight transportation movements. Proficient in managing shipping manifests, bills of lading, certificates of origin, and processing customs clearances via Dubai Trade. Skilled in negotiating freight rates with 3PL forwarders, scheduling container dock deliveries, and updating ERP shipment data. Focused on minimizing demurrage charges, resolving transportation delays, and communicating milestones to internal teams.

professions.name: Storekeeper
duties: Receive incoming consignments of technical materials, tools, and spare parts, inspecting boxes for transit damage.
Verify delivered material quantities and part numbers against attached purchase orders and supplier delivery notes.
Shelve and catalog inventory into designated bin, rack, and shelf locations following FIFO storage principles.
Issue materials, hand tools, and consumables to site technicians only upon receiving signed store requisition forms.
Update stock ledgers, bin cards, and inventory software systems immediately after completing receipts or issues.
Monitor minimum stock reorder levels across critical spares, raising purchase indents before items run out of stock.
Manage the tool crib, tracking checked-out power tools, multimeters, and ladders using token or tag systems.
Inspect returned tools and unused project materials, cleaning items and restocking them back to proper shelves.
Maintain cleanliness, ventilation, and fire safety protocols across store aisles, chemical bays, and tool racks.
Participate in monthly stocktaking exercises, reconciling physical quantities against software balances to find gaps.
professions.summary: Systematic Storekeeper experienced in managing industrial tool cribs, technical material stores, and spare parts inventory rooms. Skilled in inspecting inbound supplier shipments against purchase orders, logging material receiving notes, and managing bin cards. Proficient in issuing tools and consumables against signed requisitions, monitoring minimum stock levels, and enforcing FIFO picking. Dedicated to maintaining organized, clean aisles, safe chemical storage containment, and assisting with periodic audits.

professions.name: Assistant Storekeeper
duties: Assist the storekeeper in unloading incoming delivery trucks, containers, and supplier vans at the loading dock.
Unpack wooden crates and cardboard cartons, checking physical items against delivery notes and packing slips.
Move boxes and technical parts to allocated storage racks using hand pallet jacks, trollies, and stepladders.
Affix barcode tags, part number labels, and bin location cards onto shelves and newly received materials.
Retrieve requested tools, hardware fittings, and consumables from shelves against signed material issue slips.
Clean, wipe, and organize store shelves, keeping aisles clear of empty cartons, plastic wrap, and wooden pallets.
Conduct daily physical counts of fast-moving items, reporting stock shortages directly to the lead storekeeper.
Assist in checking returned equipment, wiping off dirt, and placing items back into designated storage bins.
Verify that flammable liquids, chemical cans, and adhesives are placed in approved ventilated containment cabinets.
Lock up store gates, turn off warehouse lights, and check window latches at the conclusion of every working shift.
professions.summary: Supportive and reliable Assistant Storekeeper experienced in assisting daily material handling, storage, and inventory control functions. Skilled in unloading delivery trucks, inspecting cartons for outer damage, unpacking parts, and affixing barcode shelf labels. Proficient in operating manual pallet jacks, picking requested parts for technicians, and conducting physical shelf counts. Committed to maintaining clean stock aisles, securing flammable materials, and locking storage areas at shift close.

professions.name: Inventory Clerk
duties: Execute scheduled daily and weekly cycle counts of physical inventory across warehouse aisles and storage yards.
Scan item barcodes and serial numbers using RF handheld terminals to verify quantities against system records.
Investigate stock discrepancies between physical shelf counts and ERP balances, tracking down missing paperwork.
Record damaged, expired, obsolete, or non-conforming goods and move them into designated quarantine locations.
Track batch numbers, manufacturing dates, and expiration timelines to ensure proper FIFO/FEFO stock rotation.
Reconcile receiving reports with purchase orders to confirm all delivered goods are accurately recorded into software.
Prepare detailed inventory variance reports and submit adjustment recommendations to inventory controllers.
Participate in quarterly and year-end complete physical stocktaking audits alongside external financial auditors.
Monitor stock movements between multiple branches or project site stores, verifying transfer waybills.
Maintain digital archives of material receiving reports, stock transfer notes, and disposal write-off certificates.
professions.summary: Analytical Inventory Clerk proficient in maintaining stock count accuracy across warehouse storage bays and enterprise ERP systems. Skilled in operating barcode RF scanners, conducting systematic weekly cycle counts, and logging physical stock receipts. Proficient in investigating inventory count variances, documenting damaged or expired merchandise, and tracking product batch numbers. Dedicated to supporting external financial audits, tracking multi-site transfers, and generating inventory discrepancy reports.

professions.name: Order Picker
duties: Review electronic pick lists or paper pick sheets to identify required SKUs, batch numbers, and bin locations.
Navigate warehouse aisles following optimized pick paths to retrieve items quickly without back-tracking.
Locate correct storage racks and verify product barcodes using handheld RF scanners before retrieving stock.
Inspect picked items visually for packaging tears, dents, broken seals, or upcoming expiry dates.
Pick specified quantities of goods accurately from bulk pallets, flow racks, and shelving bins.
Place picked merchandise neatly into picking totes, roll cages, or mobile picking carts to avoid crushing.
Flag empty bin locations or stock mismatches in the picking system so inventory teams can replenish stock.
Transport filled picking carts to designated packing benches or sortation conveyor stations.
Follow safe manual handling techniques when lifting heavy cases, bending knees and keeping loads close to the body.
Maintain picking speed and target picks-per-hour quotas while maintaining zero-error accuracy rates.
professions.summary: Fast and accurate Order Picker experienced in fulfilling customer and site requisition orders inside high-density distribution centers. Proficient in reading pick lists, operating RF scanners, and navigating warehouse aisles following optimized pick routes. Skilled in verifying product codes, inspecting merchandise packaging, and picking items into sorting totes without damaging goods. Focused on meeting picking quotas, maintaining zero-error pick rates, and adhering to safe manual lifting postures.

professions.name: Packer
duties: Receive picked product bins at packing stations and cross-verify contents against packing slip item lists.
Select appropriate carton sizes, poly mailers, or shipping crates based on product dimensions and weight.
Wrap fragile and delicate merchandise securely with bubble wrap, foam sheets, or corrugated paper rolls.
Fill carton voids using air pillows, paper void-fill, or packing peanuts to prevent contents from shifting in transit.
Seal box tops and bottoms securely with reinforced water-activated tape or heavy-duty packaging tape guns.
Operate manual strapping tools and automated heat-sealing band strapping machines for heavy packages.
Print and affix accurate shipping waybills, barcode labels, and "Fragile" handling stickers onto outer boxes.
Measure packaged carton dimensions and weigh finished boxes on scales to record accurate shipping data.
Stack sealed cartons onto outgoing dispatch pallets, organizing them by carrier route or destination hub.
Keep packing tables stocked with cartons, tape rolls, tissue paper, and bubble wrap, keeping work areas clean.
professions.summary: Quality-focused Packer experienced in preparing, cushioning, and boxing diverse customer items for safe transport and distribution. Skilled in selecting appropriate box sizes, wrapping breakable items with bubble wrap, and utilizing void-fill materials effectively. Proficient in applying reinforced packaging tape, operating strapping machines, and fixing accurate shipping and fragile labels. Dedicated to packing speed, verifying contents against packing slips, and stacking sealed boxes cleanly onto pallets.

professions.name: Delivery Courier
duties: Sort and load daily parcel shipments into delivery vans according to street sequence and delivery stop priority.
Drive delivery vehicles safely across assigned urban zones, adhering strictly to UAE road traffic regulations.
Navigate city routes, tower basements, and residential communities using GPS navigation applications.
Contact customers via phone or SMS prior to arrival to confirm presence and obtain community gate passes.
Deliver parcels directly to customers' doorsteps, verifying consignee identity and obtaining digital signatures (POD).
Collect cash-on-delivery (COD) payments, issue receipts, and keep collected cash secure throughout the shift.
Handle package returns and customer exchanges, scanning barcodes and handing over return receipts.
Update parcel delivery statuses in real-time on handheld courier mobile apps (Delivered, Rescheduled, Failed).
Return undelivered parcels to the central sorting hub at the end of the day, logging precise failure reasons.
Reconcile collected COD cash balances and credit card payment receipts with the dispatch cashier daily.
professions.summary: Customer-oriented Delivery Courier experienced in managing express parcel delivery routes across residential towers and commercial communities. Proficient in sorting packages by street sequence, navigating city routes via GPS apps, and contacting customers ahead of arrival. Skilled in collecting cash-on-delivery (COD) payments, handling package returns, and capturing digital customer signatures. Dedicated to vehicle road safety, safeguarding client shipments, and meeting daily scheduled delivery targets.

professions.name: Dispatch Rider
duties: Operate delivery motorcycles safely through city streets, following local speed limits and lane rules strictly.
Wear all mandatory personal protective riding gear including certified helmets, riding jackets, gloves, and boots.
Receive food orders or express courier items from restaurant kitchens or dispatch hubs within allocated pickup times.
Pack warm and cold items separately into insulated delivery bags, securing drinks upright with drink cup holders.
Fasten delivery top boxes securely to motorcycle rear racks to prevent order damage or tipping during turns.
Navigate urban shortcut corridors and arterial routes efficiently to meet guaranteed customer delivery deadlines.
Approach customer residences politely, hand over orders cleanly, and complete digital delivery sign-offs on the app.
Manage small cash transactions accurately, providing exact change and logging collected amounts in the rider app.
Perform daily pre-ride motorcycle checks, including tire tread wear, brake pads, chain tension, and headlamps.
Keep the delivery thermal box sanitized, clean, and odor-free inside, wiping it down between consecutive delivery runs.
professions.summary: Agile and defensive Dispatch Rider experienced in delivering food orders and urgent courier documents across high-density urban streets. Proficient in motorcycle handling, wearing mandatory protective riding gear, and navigating shortcut corridors safely within traffic laws. Skilled in packing insulated delivery top-boxes, securing hot and cold items separately, and handling small cash transactions. Dedicated to fast delivery turnarounds, customer service, and daily motorcycle mechanical inspections.

professions.name: Fleet Coordinator
duties: Monitor live locations, vehicle idling times, and speed alerts of company fleet vehicles using GPS tracking portals.
Schedule preventative maintenance, mechanical servicing, and tire replacements with authorized repair garages.
Manage annual vehicle registration renewals, passing tests, and commercial insurance policies with RTA / Tasjeel.
Assign delivery vans, pickups, and passenger cars to drivers, maintaining signed vehicle checkout logbooks.
Track corporate fuel card usage, Salik toll charges, and traffic fine deductions, auditing usage anomalies.
Conduct random physical inspections of fleet vehicles to check body condition, cleanliness, and tire safety.
Coordinate emergency breakdown recoveries, mobile tire repairs, and replacement vehicle dispatches for stranded drivers.
Assist drivers involved in traffic accidents with reporting procedures to obtain police reports for insurance claims.
Verify that all company drivers possess valid UAE driving licenses matching their assigned vehicle categories.
Compile monthly fleet operating reports detailing fuel consumption, maintenance expenses, and vehicle downtimes.
professions.summary: Detail-oriented Fleet Coordinator experienced in supervising vehicle utilization, maintenance schedules, and administrative compliance for company fleets. Proficient in monitoring GPS tracking dashboards to track driver speeding and route deviations, and managing fuel card accounts. Skilled in coordinating routine garage servicing, tire replacements, annual RTA passing tests, and processing accident reports. Dedicated to minimizing vehicle downtime, controlling running costs, and verifying driver license validity across fleets.

professions.name: Restaurant Supervisor
duties: Supervise front-of-house dining operations, coordinating waitstaff, runners, and hostesses during busy meal shifts.
Conduct pre-shift briefings to review daily specials, 86'd (out-of-stock) menu items, and VIP guest bookings.
Monitor dining floor flow, manage table turnover times, and assist hostesses with seating arrangements.
Handle customer complaints regarding food quality, delay, or service errors promptly with professional tact.
Ensure dining room tables, cutlery, glassware, and condiment stations are set according to brand standards.
Monitor floor staff adherence to UAE municipality food safety, personal grooming, and hygiene regulations.
Manage POS opening and closing procedures, reconciles cash drawers, and verifies credit card batch settlements.
Train new waitstaff on table etiquette, order of service, menu ingredient details, and upselling techniques.
Oversee dining room closing duties, ensuring floors are swept, side stations restocked, and lights secured.
Prepare daily manager shift reports summarizing total sales revenue, customer headcounts, and voided orders.
professions.summary: Dynamic Restaurant Supervisor with proven front-of-house leadership skills in managing fast-paced dining and hospitality environments. Skilled in assigning waitstaff table sections, conducting pre-service menu briefings, and managing floor table turnover rates. Experienced in resolving guest dining complaints diplomatically, managing POS cashier balancing, and enforcing local food hygiene rules. Dedicated to training floor teams on service etiquette, supporting upselling, and driving positive customer dining experiences.

professions.name: Dining Room Captain
duties: Lead and manage an assigned section of dining tables, ensuring all seated guests receive attentive service.
Greet guests warmly upon arrival, pull out chairs, present menus, and explain chef specials and promotions.
Take detailed food and beverage orders accurately, noting customer allergies and special dietary restrictions.
Suggest beverage pairings, appetizers, and premium side dishes to enhance guest experience and boost average spend.
Enter food and drink orders into the restaurant POS terminal immediately to trigger kitchen display tickets.
Coordinate with kitchen runners to ensure appetizers, main courses, and desserts are served in correct sequence.
Check back on tables within two minutes of food service to verify customer satisfaction with taste and temperature.
Oversee table crumb clearing, used plate clearing, and water glass refilling performed by section waitstaff.
Present guest checks neatly in bill folders, process card transactions, and bid departing guests a warm farewell.
Ensure side stations within the section are fully stocked with clean cutlery, folded napkins, and spare menus.
professions.summary: Attentive Dining Room Captain experienced in directing table sections and delivering high-touch guest service in fine-dining restaurants. Skilled in welcoming patrons, presenting menus, detailing daily chef specials, and recommending wine or beverage pairings. Proficient in monitoring table service sequences, coordinating with the kitchen line for timely delivery, and checking on guest satisfaction. Focused on staff presentation standards, managing station mise en place, and executing smooth billing transactions.

professions.name: Waiter
duties: Welcome guests to their tables with a polite greeting, unfold napkins, and pour complimentary welcome water.
Memorize food menu ingredients, preparation styles, allergens, and daily kitchen specials to advise customers.
Carry service trays loaded with drinks and food dishes safely across crowded restaurant dining areas.
Serve dishes to guests from the correct side without leaning over diners or touching plate rims.
Refill water and beverage glasses proactively throughout the dining experience without being asked.
Clear soiled plates, silverware, and empty glassware promptly between courses using proper plate-clearing holds.
Crumb dining tables and reset fresh cutlery and dessert spoons prior to serving dessert courses.
Polish silverware, glassware, and chinaware using hot water and lint-free cloths during service prep hours.
Restock service stations with napkins, straws, ice buckets, salt and pepper shakers, and menu booklets.
Wipe down, sanitize, and reset dining tables immediately after guests depart to prepare for the next seating.
professions.summary: Courteous and energetic Waiter experienced in delivering attentive food and beverage table service across busy dining establishments. Proficient in memorizing menus, answering ingredient allergen inquiries, and entering orders into restaurant POS systems. Skilled in balancing service trays, serving meals from the correct side, refilling drinks, and clearing soiled plates swiftly. Dedicated to maintaining clean side stations, polishing glassware, resetting tables, and providing friendly guest service.

professions.name: Barista
duties: Dial in espresso grinders daily, adjusting grind size and dose to achieve target extraction time and flavor profile.
Pull single and double espresso shots following established recipe standards, yield ratios, and tamping pressures.
Steam and texture whole, skim, and plant-based milks to silky micro-foam at precise serving temperatures.
Pour freehand latte art designs (hearts, tulips, rosettas) to enhance visual beverage presentation.
Prepare cold brew, pour-over (V60/Chemex), iced coffees, specialty teas, and seasonal blended beverages.
Take customer beverage orders at the counter, enter customizations accurately into POS, and collect payments.
Backflush espresso group heads with cleaning detergent and soak steam wand tips at shift end.
Monitor coffee bean hoppers, syrups, cups, lids, and milk inventory, restocking service counters continuously.
Wipe down drip trays, espresso machines, and preparation counters to keep the coffee bar clean and sanitized.
Comply with food safety protocols, checking milk refrigerator temperatures and rotating cartons by expiry date.
professions.summary: Passionate and skilled Barista proficient in operating commercial espresso machinery and preparing specialty coffee and tea beverages. Expert in calibrating burr grinders, timing espresso extractions, and steaming varied milks into silky microfoam for latte art. Skilled in brewing manual pour-overs (V60), preparing cold brews, taking customer orders at registers, and managing cash. Dedicated to workspace cleanliness, sanitizing steam wands, and maintaining fresh coffee bean and syrup supplies.

professions.name: Bartender
duties: Mix, shake, stir, and garnish classic and signature cocktails according to standard bar spec sheets.
Pour draft beers, wines, champagnes, and premium spirits using precise jigger measures to prevent over-pouring.
Prepare fresh bar garnishes (citrus wheels, twists, herbs, dehydrated fruit) and house-made syrups before opening.
Check identification cards of patrons to verify legal drinking age prior to serving alcoholic beverages.
Engage bar patrons warmly, suggest drink selections, and take food and drink orders over the counter.
Wash, sanitize, and polish glassware continuously using bar glass-washing machines and lint-free cloths.
Observe customer behavior carefully to identify intoxication levels and tactfully refuse service when required.
Count and log bar inventory, opening bottles, keg levels, and coordinate cellar replenishments.
Reconcile bar cash floats, process credit card charges, and close bar registers at the end of service.
Strip speed rails, clean bar mats, empty ice wells, and sanitize all bar surfaces during closing routines.
professions.summary: Creative and organized Bartender skilled in cocktail mixology, speed pouring, and managing high-volume beverage service at bars. Proficient in crafting classic and signature cocktails using jiggers, preparing fresh fruit garnishes, and pouring tap beers and wines. Skilled in verifying patron legal drinking ages, recognizing signs of intoxication, and managing guest interactions professionally. Dedicated to maintaining bar counter hygiene, washing glassware, and executing daily liquor bottle inventory counts.

professions.name: Line Cook
duties: Set up cooking stations with required mise en place, prepped produce, sauces, and proteins before service starts.
Read incoming order tickets on kitchen display systems (KDS) and coordinate firing times with other stations.
Cook meats, poultry, seafood, and vegetables to specified doneness using grills, fryers, broilers, and sauté ranges.
Verify food safety temperatures using calibrated digital probe thermometers to prevent undercooking.
Plate finished dishes neatly according to chef presentation guidelines and portion control standards.
Label, date, and store raw and prepared food containers following strict FIFO and HACCP color-coding rules.
Clean, sanitize, and wipe down stainless steel worktops, cutting boards, and cooking line equipment continuously.
Filter, skim, and change cooking oil in deep fryers, properly disposing of waste fryer oil into grease barrels.
Inform the head chef or sous chef immediately when station prep items or pantry ingredients run low.
Break down line stations at closing, wrap and store ingredients in walk-in chillers, and scrub station cooktops.
professions.summary: Reliable and disciplined Line Cook experienced in executing high-volume cooking orders across saute, grill, and fryer stations. Proficient in prepping station mise en place, reading kitchen display tickets (KDS), and timing dishes to ensure synchronized service. Skilled in monitoring food internal temperatures with probe thermometers, labeling prep containers, and adhering to HACCP guidelines. Committed to station sanitation, knife safety, proper cooking oil filtration, and precise plate presentation.

professions.name: Baker
duties: Weigh and scale flour, yeast, sugar, butter, and liquids precisely using digital scales according to bakery formulas.
Mix and knead bread, roll, and pastry doughs using heavy-duty spiral and planetary commercial mixers.
Monitor dough fermentation, bulk resting, and proofing box humidity to ensure optimal dough rise.
Divide, shape, and round dough portions manually or using automated dough dividers and rounders.
Sheet and laminate puff pastry and croissant dough with butter blocks using motorized pastry sheeters.
Score proofed bread loaves with baker lames to control crust expansion during oven baking.
Load and operate deck ovens, rotary rack ovens, and convection ovens, adjusting steam injection and timers.
Bake artisan breads, baguettes, buns, and basic pastries to desired internal temperatures and crust colors.
Unload baked goods onto cooling racks, applying glazes, sugar washes, or seed toppings while warm.
Sweep flour off workbenches, scrape marble tables, and clean mixer bowls and dough hooks at the end of the shift.
professions.summary: Artisan Baker experienced in scaling, mixing, proofing, and baking an assortment of breads, buns, and morning pastries. Proficient in managing yeast fermentation timelines, operating spiral mixers, and sheeting laminated pastry doughs with butter blocks. Skilled in scoring bread loaves, loading commercial deck and rotary rack ovens, and regulating steam injection levels. Dedicated to recipe precision, clean workbench sanitation, and delivering baked products with consistent crust and crumb quality.

professions.name: Kitchen Steward
duties: Operate industrial flight-type and pass-through dishwashers, monitoring wash temperatures and sanitizing rinse cycles.
Scrape, rinse, and rack soiled plates, bowls, and glassware before running them through wash cycles.
Scrub burned pots, heavy saucepans, baking trays, and gastronorm pans manually in three-compartment sink bays.
Inspect washed dishware for residual food stains, rewashing dirty pieces before stacking clean stock.
Sort, organize, and return clean china, cutlery, pots, and utensils to designated kitchen stations and storage racks.
Empty, clean, and line kitchen garbage bins, taking trash bags to external garbage compactors and skips.
Segregate kitchen food waste, cardboard cartons, and cooking oils according to UAE municipal waste recycling rules.
Sweep, degrease, scrub, and mop kitchen floors, floor drains, and walk-in cold room floors with rubber squeegees.
Handle, dilute, and store commercial cleaning chemicals safely using appropriate gloves and protective face aprons.
Clean kitchen exhaust hoods, grease filters, stainless steel wall panels, and pest fly catchers during deep cleaning.
professions.summary: Hardworking Kitchen Steward experienced in maintaining sanitation, hygiene, and dishwashing operations across busy commercial kitchens. Skilled in operating high-capacity conveyor dishwashing machines, descaling wash tanks, and monitoring water temperatures. Proficient in manual heavy pot-washing, scrubbing grease filters, and segregating food waste according to municipal rules. Dedicated to restocking clean culinary equipment, handling sanitizing chemicals safely, and keeping kitchen floors scrubbed and dry.

professions.name: Housekeeping Supervisor
duties: Allocate daily room cleaning assignments to room attendants based on hotel occupancy and guest arrival lists.
Inspect cleaned departure, stayover, and VIP guest rooms to verify spotless hygiene and linen standards.
Update room status codes (Clean, Vacant, Inspected, Out of Order) in the hotel Property Management System (PMS).
Check bed linen quality, bathroom fixtures, amenity replenishments, and mini-bar stocks during room checks.
Report maintenance snags (leaking taps, blown lights, faulty ACs) to the engineering department immediately.
Log, catalog, and store items left behind by guests according to the hotel's secure Lost and Found policies.
Monitor consumption of guest room amenities, cleaning detergents, and linens, placing reorders as needed.
Train room attendants on speed cleaning techniques, proper ergonomics, and chemical safety standards.
Coordinate deep cleaning schedules for guest room carpets, curtains, mattress rotations, and marble polishing.
Investigate guest housekeeping complaints promptly, dispatching attendants to rectify issues with courtesy.
professions.summary: Detail-focused Housekeeping Supervisor experienced in managing room attendant teams and inspecting hotel guest rooms and public floors. Proficient in allocating daily room assignments, auditing rooms for spotless cleanliness, and updating room statuses in PMS software. Skilled in managing hotel linen inventory, monitoring guest supply usage, and enforcing secure lost-and-found procedures. Dedicated to reporting engineering defects promptly, training attendants on cleaning speed, and ensuring guest comfort.

professions.name: Room Attendant
duties: Stock and organize housekeeping service trolleys with clean linens, fresh towels, amenities, and cleaning supplies.
Strip soiled sheets, duvet covers, and pillowcases from guest beds and replace them with fresh hotel-grade linens.
Make beds with tight hospital corners, smooth duvets, and plump pillows according to brand standards.
Scrub, disinfect, and dry bathroom surfaces including bathtubs, glass showers, toilets, vanities, and wall tiles.
Vacuum guest room carpets, rugs, and furniture upholstery, getting into corners and under bed frames.
Dust, wipe, and polish desks, headboards, mirrors, television screens, and wardrobe interiors.
Replenish bathroom toiletries, bathrobes, slippers, coffee/tea station supplies, and complimentary waters.
Check minibar contents against price lists, restock consumed beverages, and note charges on billing sheets.
Perform evening turndown service, folding back bed covers, drawing curtains, and placing night amenities.
Turn in all items found left behind in vacated rooms to the housekeeping supervisor immediately with room details.
professions.summary: Thorough and efficient Room Attendant experienced in servicing stayover and departure guest rooms to high hospitality brand standards. Skilled in stripping and remaking beds with crisp hospital corners, dusting furniture, and vacuuming carpets and upholstered chairs. Proficient in scrubbing, sanitizing, and polishing bathroom tiles, vanities, and mirrors, and restocking guest toiletries. Dedicated to organizing housekeeping trolleys, respecting guest privacy, and handing in forgotten property immediately.

professions.name: Bellboy
duties: Greet arriving hotel guests warmly at the main entrance, opening vehicle doors and welcoming them to the property.
Unload suitcases and baggage carefully from guest cars and taxis onto brass luggage trolleys (birdcages).
Tag guest luggage with identifying claim checks and verify the total number of bags with the guest.
Escort guests to their assigned rooms upon check-in, explaining room features, lighting controls, and amenities.
Deliver stored luggage, laundry bundles, couriers, and room parcels directly to guest rooms in a timely manner.
Store baggage securely in the hotel luggage holding room, logging ticket numbers and customer details.
Retrieve stored baggage for departing guests, assisting them with curbside loading into airport taxis or limousines.
Provide accurate directions, travel advice, and attraction recommendations around the UAE to inquiring hotel guests.
Keep the main hotel lobby, revolving entrance doors, and luggage storage rooms neat, tidy, and unobstructed.
Run internal front-office errands, deliver VIP welcome gifts to rooms, and distribute guest mail and newspapers.
professions.summary: Friendly and professional Bellboy experienced in delivering warm welcoming and front-office concierge assistance to arriving hotel guests. Skilled in greeting guests at vehicle doors, safely handling heavy baggage onto luggage carts, and escorting patrons to rooms. Proficient in explaining room amenities and temperature controls, storing guest luggage securely, and organizing curbside taxi departures. Committed to maintaining an organized, pristine lobby area, running guest errands, and offering local tourist directions.

professions.name: IT Support Technician
duties: Install, configure, and update operating systems (Windows, macOS) and enterprise productivity suites on user laptops.
Troubleshoot and resolve desktop hardware, peripheral, monitor, docking station, and laptop malfunctions.
Manage user accounts, reset passwords, and assign folder access permissions within Microsoft Active Directory / Entra ID.
Set up and terminate Cat6 network patch cables at wall faceplates, patch panels, and desktop network jacks.
Install, share, and troubleshoot office multifunction network printers, scanners, and toner cartridge replacements.
Log, prioritize, track, and close user technical support tickets within established service level agreements (SLAs).
Configure company email profiles (Outlook), multi-factor authentication (MFA) apps, and secure VPN clients on devices.
Diagnose and remove malware, spyware, and unauthorized software, ensuring endpoint antivirus protection is active.
Prepare and test audio-visual setups, conference room displays, video bars, and microphones for corporate meetings.
Maintain an organized hardware inventory register, logging issued assets, serial numbers, and equipment returns.
professions.summary: Customer-focused IT Support Technician skilled in deploying, diagnosing, and maintaining office hardware, laptops, and peripheral systems. Proficient in installing operating systems (Windows/macOS), configuring productivity software, and managing Active Directory user permissions. Skilled in terminating Cat6 network drops, troubleshooting local network printers, and supporting remote workers via VPN tools. Dedicated to managing helpdesk tickets within agreed SLAs, removing malware threats, and maintaining asset inventory logs.

professions.name: Data Entry Clerk
duties: Transcribe text, numerical data, customer information, and financial transactions from paper forms into software systems.
Review source documents for incomplete data, missing signatures, or obvious errors before keying in details.
Maintain high typing speed and accuracy rates while processing large volumes of repetitive entries daily.
Verify entered data by cross-checking computer outputs against source documents to catch entry mistakes.
Update, clean, and eliminate duplicate records within company databases, spreadsheets, and CRM platforms.
Scan physical invoices, contracts, receipts, and identity documents, saving digital files with standard naming schemes.
Sort, index, and file physical paperwork into designated archive boxes and filing cabinets after data entry.
Generate simple data export spreadsheets and summary reports in Microsoft Excel using filters and sorting tools.
Safeguard confidential business and customer information, adhering to data privacy and non-disclosure standards.
Back up digital data files regularly onto designated cloud storage drives to prevent data loss.
professions.summary: Fast, highly accurate Data Entry Clerk proficient in alphanumeric touch typing and transcribing complex records into databases. Skilled in verifying source paperwork for errors, updating customer records across CRM platforms, and organizing Excel spreadsheets. Proficient in operating high-speed document scanners, indexing digital files into cloud archives, and eliminating duplicated data. Dedicated to confidential data privacy practices, maintaining high daily keystroke outputs, and performing regular file backups.
